fields.label: Resource Scope
fields.description: Optional connector-local resource allowlist as a JSON array. Leave it blank to set no local resource restriction and use list_projects and list_logstores to discover resources allowed by RAM. Each item requires project; endpoint is optional and defaults to the connection endpoint. Omitting logstores allows every Logstore in that Project. When logstores is provided, it must contain only non-empty, unique Logstore names and only those Logstores are accessible. This local allowlist does not replace Alibaba Cloud RAM permissions.

actions.description: List Apiframe models and their current generation control surfaces.

auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Apify API token used with the Authorization Bearer header. Create it in Apify Console settings: https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations.

actions.name: get_actor
actions.description: Retrieve metadata for one Apify actor by identifier.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated Apify user account.

actions.name: get_dataset_items
actions.description: Retrieve JSON items from one Apify dataset.

actions.name: get_run
actions.description: Retrieve the current status and storage identifiers for one Apify actor run.

actions.name: run_actor
actions.description: Start one Apify actor run with an optional JSON input payload.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: APIpie AI API key used with the Authorization Bearer header. Create or manage keys at https://apipie.ai/profile/api-keys.

actions.name: create_chat_completion
actions.description: Create a non-streaming APIpie AI OpenAI-compatible chat completion.

actions.name: create_embedding
actions.description: Generate APIpie AI embeddings for one or more text inputs.

actions.name: list_detailed_models
actions.description: List detailed APIpie AI model metadata available to the current API key.

actions.name: list_models
actions.description: List the APIpie AI models available to the current API key.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: APIVerve API key passed in the X-API-Key request header. Create a free account at https://dashboard.apiverve.com/signup, then find the key in the API Keys section of https://dashboard.apiverve.com.

actions.name: calculate_age
actions.description: Calculate age details from a date of birth using APIVerve Age Calculator.

actions.name: convert_currency
actions.description: Convert an amount between currencies using APIVerve Currency Converter.

actions.name: find_antonyms
actions.description: Find antonyms for a word using APIVerve Antonym Finder.

actions.name: generate_advice
actions.description: Generate a random piece of advice using APIVerve Advice Generator.

actions.name: get_air_quality
actions.description: Get current air quality by city or ZIP code using APIVerve Air Quality.

actions.name: get_airport_distance
actions.description: Get distance and flight estimates between two airports using IATA codes.

actions.name: get_word_definition
actions.description: Get definitions for a word using APIVerve Dictionary.

actions.name: lookup_airlines
actions.description: Look up airlines by name or IATA code using APIVerve Airline Lookup.

actions.name: lookup_airport
actions.description: Look up airport information by IATA code using APIVerve Airports Lookup.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Apollo API key sent with the x-api-key header. Create it in Settings > Integrations > API Keys: https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key. The first-pass actions require a master API key.

actions.name: enrich_organization
actions.description: Enrich an Apollo organization by domain.

actions.name: enrich_person
actions.description: Enrich an Apollo person with the first-pass matching inputs.

actions.name: get_api_usage_stats
actions.description: Retrieve Apollo API usage statistics for the current team and key.

actions.name: search_organizations
actions.description: Search Apollo organizations with the first-pass organization filters.

actions.name: search_people
actions.description: Search Apollo people with the first-pass prospecting filters.

provider.description: Browse apps and App Store versions, run TestFlight distribution, answer App Store reviews, and read team members through Apple's App Store Connect API.

fields.label: Key ID
fields.description: The key identifier shown next to the API key in App Store Connect under Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API (Team Keys), or on your user profile for an Individual API Key.

fields.label: Issuer ID
fields.description: The issuer ID printed above the team key list in App Store Connect. Required for team keys. Leave it empty for an Individual API Key, which is authenticated by the key alone.

fields.label: Private Key (.p8)
fields.description: The full contents of the AuthKey_<KEYID>.p8 file downloaded when the key was created, a PKCS#8 PEM holding an EC P-256 key. Apple offers the download only once. Escaped \n line breaks are accepted.

actions.name: add_achievements_to_game_center_activity
actions.description: Attach achievements to a Game Center activity so players can earn them while the activity is played. Achievements already attached are left as they are.

actions.name: add_beta_testers_to_group
actions.description: Add existing TestFlight testers to one group so they receive the builds that group can install.

actions.name: add_build_to_beta_groups
actions.description: Make one build available to TestFlight groups so their testers can install it.

actions.name: add_builds_to_beta_group
actions.description: Make several builds available to one TestFlight group so its testers can install them.

actions.name: add_compatibility_versions_to_game_center_app_version
actions.description: Mark earlier Game Center app versions as multiplayer compatible with this one. Adds to the versions already listed instead of replacing them.

actions.name: add_individual_testers_to_build
actions.description: Assign existing TestFlight testers to one build individually so they can install it without belonging to a group.

actions.name: add_leaderboards_to_game_center_activity
actions.description: Attach leaderboards to a Game Center activity so scores made while it is played are posted to them. Leaderboards already attached are left as they are.

actions.name: add_leaderboards_to_game_center_leaderboard_set
actions.description: Put more existing leaderboards into a Game Center leaderboard set. The leaderboards already in the set are kept.

actions.name: add_review_submission_item
actions.description: Add one record to an open review submission. Give exactly one of appStoreVersionId, appCustomProductPageVersionId, appStoreVersionExperimentId, appStoreVersionExperimentV2Id, or appEventId. The item can be removed again with delete_review_submission_item before the submission is sent.

actions.name: add_visible_apps_to_user
actions.description: Make additional apps visible to a team member who does not have access to all apps.

actions.name: cancel_review_submission
actions.description: Cancel a review submission, removing it from the App Review queue. Its items return to their previous state and a new submission is needed to submit them again.

actions.name: cancel_user_invitation
actions.description: Cancel a pending team invitation. The activation link stops working; invite the person again if needed.

actions.name: clear_sandbox_tester_purchase_history
actions.description: Erase the purchase history of sandbox testers so they can test first-time purchases again. The history cannot be restored.

actions.name: create_accessibility_declaration
actions.description: Create a draft accessibility declaration for one device family of an app. The draft is not shown on the App Store until update_accessibility_declaration publishes it.

actions.name: create_alternative_distribution_domain
actions.description: Register the base web domain that serves a marketplace app or web distribution app. All app pages and the marketplace sitemap must live on this domain, and it is enabled for every alternative distribution app on the account.

actions.name: create_alternative_distribution_key
actions.description: Upload the public half of an alternative distribution key pair. Without appId the key applies to every alternative distribution app on the account; with appId it is tied to that marketplace or web distribution app. The private half never goes to Apple and signs the marketplace JWTs or install verification.

actions.name: create_alternative_distribution_package
actions.description: Generate the alternative distribution package for an already approved App Store version. Versions approved after alternative distribution was enabled get their package automatically; use this for versions that were approved before.

actions.name: create_analytics_report_request
actions.description: Ask App Store Connect to generate analytics reports for an app. ONGOING produces new daily, weekly, and monthly reports until the request is deleted or stops for inactivity; ONE_TIME_SNAPSHOT delivers historical data once. Reports appear asynchronously, so list them later.

actions.name: create_android_to_ios_app_mapping_detail
actions.description: Map an Android app to this app by its package name and signing certificate fingerprints, so Android users migrating to iPhone are offered this app.

actions.name: create_app_availability
actions.description: Set the territory availability of an app: whether it is offered in new territories automatically, and for each listed territory whether it is available, its release date and whether pre-orders are enabled. The new configuration replaces the current availability of the app in every territory, so list every territory the app should stay available in.

actions.name: create_app_clip_advanced_experience
actions.description: Create an advanced App Clip experience for an invocation URL with its localized card text and optional place. App Store Connect requires a header image reserved beforehand through the appClipAdvancedExperienceImages endpoint (a binary upload, available through the proxy); pass its identifier as headerImageId.

actions.name: create_app_clip_app_store_review_detail
actions.description: Provide the invocation URLs App Review uses to test a default App Clip experience. Each experience has at most one review detail; use update_app_clip_app_store_review_detail to change it.

actions.name: create_app_clip_default_experience
actions.description: Create a default experience for an App Clip, optionally attached to the App Store version it ships with or copied from an existing experience.

actions.name: create_app_clip_default_experience_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to a default App Clip experience with the subtitle shown on the App Clip card in that locale. The header image is uploaded separately in App Store Connect.

actions.name: create_app_custom_product_page
actions.description: Create a custom product page for an app. Copy the metadata of an App Store version (appStoreVersionTemplateId) or of another custom product page (customProductPageTemplateId), or create the first page version inline with a deep link and localized promotional text. The page starts hidden until its first version passes App Review; use list_app_custom_product_page_versions to find the version to work on.

actions.name: create_app_custom_product_page_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to a custom product page version with optional promotional text. Screenshots and app previews for the locale are uploaded separately. App Store Connect rejects a locale the version already has.

actions.name: create_app_custom_product_page_version
actions.description: Create a new editable version of a custom product page, for example to change it after the current version was approved. App Store Connect rejects a new version while the page already has one that is still being prepared or reviewed.

actions.name: create_app_encryption_declaration
actions.description: Create an export compliance declaration for an app that uses non-exempt encryption. App Store Connect reviews it and assigns a compliance code; the declaration cannot be edited afterwards, only replaced by a new one. Supporting documents must be uploaded separately.

actions.name: create_app_event
actions.description: Create a draft in-app event for an app. Add localizations with create_app_event_localization before submitting the event for review in App Store Connect.

actions.name: create_app_event_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to an in-app event with the name and descriptions shown in that locale. App Store Connect rejects a locale the event already has.

actions.name: create_app_info_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to an app info record with the app name and optional subtitle and privacy URLs shown in that locale. App Store Connect rejects a locale the record already has.

actions.name: create_app_price_schedule
actions.description: Set the price schedule of an app: the base territory plus the manual prices, each a price point (which already encodes its territory) with an optional date range. App Store Connect derives the prices of every other territory from the base territory price. The new schedule replaces the current prices and any scheduled price changes of the app. Find price point identifiers with list_app_price_points.

actions.name: create_app_store_review_detail
actions.description: Enter the App Review contact details, demo account, and notes for an App Store version that has none yet.

actions.name: create_app_store_version
actions.description: Create a new App Store version for an app on one platform. The version starts in PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION and can be deleted again until it is submitted for review.

actions.name: create_app_store_version_experiment
actions.description: Create a product page optimization test for an app on one platform. The test starts in PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION; add treatments with create_app_store_version_experiment_treatment, then start it with update_app_store_version_experiment once its treatments are approved.

actions.name: create_app_store_version_experiment_treatment
actions.description: Add a treatment to a product page optimization test, optionally using an alternate app icon bundled with the app. Add locales to the treatment with create_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization before uploading its screenshots.

actions.name: create_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to a treatment so screenshots and app previews can be uploaded for it. App Store Connect rejects a locale the treatment already has.

actions.name: create_app_store_version_localization
actions.description: Add App Store metadata for one locale to an App Store version. The locale must be enabled for the app and must not already have a localization on this version.

actions.name: create_app_store_version_phased_release
actions.description: Enable phased release for an App Store version so an approved update rolls out to automatic-update users over seven days. Can be removed again with delete_app_store_version_phased_release before the version is released.

actions.name: create_app_store_version_promotion
actions.description: Promote the winning treatment of a product page optimization test to the default product page: its screenshots, previews, and app icon are applied to the given App Store version, replacing that version's current product page assets. Use list_app_store_version_experiments to find the control version (latestControlVersionId) the test ran against.

actions.name: create_background_asset
actions.description: Create an Apple-hosted background asset pack record for an app. The record starts without versions; create a version next, then upload and commit the asset pack archive through the generic proxy or Xcode.

actions.name: create_background_asset_version
actions.description: Create a new version record for a background asset pack. App Store Connect assigns the next version number automatically; the version stays in AWAITING_UPLOAD until the asset pack archive is uploaded and committed, which needs the binary upload endpoints outside these actions.

actions.name: create_beta_app_clip_invocation
actions.description: Add an App Clip experience that testers launch from the TestFlight app, creating its localized titles in the same request. At least one localization is required.

actions.name: create_beta_app_clip_invocation_localization
actions.description: Add a localized title in one more locale to an existing TestFlight App Clip invocation.

actions.name: create_beta_app_localization
actions.description: Create the TestFlight test information of an app for a locale that has none yet: the description, feedback email, and URLs testers see in TestFlight.

actions.name: create_beta_build_localization
actions.description: Create the "What to Test" notes of one build for a locale that has none yet. App Store Connect rejects a second record for the same locale; use update_build_test_notes to change existing notes.

actions.name: create_beta_group
actions.description: Create a TestFlight group for an app, optionally enabling its public invitation link.

actions.name: create_beta_recruitment_criterion
actions.description: Set recruitment criteria on a TestFlight group so only testers on the listed device families and OS versions can join through its public link. A group can hold one set of criteria; update or delete it afterwards.

actions.name: create_beta_tester
actions.description: Invite a TestFlight tester by email. App Store Connect only creates a tester that is assigned to something, so pass at least one of betaGroupIds or buildIds.

actions.name: create_bundle_id
actions.description: Register a new bundle ID (App ID) with the team. Capabilities are added afterwards with enable_bundle_id_capability.

actions.name: create_certificate
actions.description: Issue a new signing certificate from a certificate signing request (CSR). Apple Pay and pass type certificates also take the merchant ID or pass type ID they belong to. Developer ID certificates for macOS can only be created in the Apple Developer website or Xcode, and Apple caps how many certificates of each type a team may hold.

actions.name: create_ci_workflow
actions.description: Create an Xcode Cloud workflow for a product. Give it at least one action and, for automatic builds, one or more start conditions; without start conditions it can only be started manually.

actions.name: create_end_app_availability_pre_order
actions.description: End the pre-order of an app in the given territories and release it there immediately. This is how a pre-order for the whole app is ended: pass the territory availabilities of every territory the app is on pre-order in. The pre-order cannot be resumed afterwards.

actions.name: create_end_user_license_agreement
actions.description: Attach a custom end user license agreement to an app for the given territories. Apple's standard EULA keeps applying elsewhere. App Store Connect rejects a second agreement for the same app.

actions.name: create_game_center_achievement
actions.description: Create a Game Center achievement together with its first version. Pass gameCenterDetailId when the achievement belongs to a single app, or gameCenterGroupId when it is shared by every app of a Game Center group. The achievement has no player-facing text yet; read the first version with list_game_center_achievement_versions and add locales with create_game_center_achievement_localization.

actions.name: create_game_center_achievement_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to a Game Center achievement version with the name and the two descriptions players see before and after they earn the achievement. The achievement image for the locale is uploaded separately. App Store Connect rejects a locale the version already has.

actions.name: create_game_center_achievement_version
actions.description: Create a new version of a Game Center achievement. Editing the player-facing text of an achievement that is already live goes through a new version: add or change its localizations, and the version carries them through App Review.

actions.name: create_game_center_activity
actions.description: Create a Game Center activity for one app (gameCenterDetailId) or for a group of apps (gameCenterGroupId). Pass fallbackUrl to create the first activity version together with the activity; leave it out and no version is created, so add one afterwards with create_game_center_activity_version before the activity can be localized.

actions.name: create_game_center_activity_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to a Game Center activity version with the name and description players see in it. App Store Connect rejects a locale the version already has.

actions.name: create_game_center_activity_version
actions.description: Create a new version of a Game Center activity, for example to change its localizations or its default image after the current version was released. The new version starts in PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION.

actions.name: create_game_center_app_version
actions.description: Turn Game Center on for one App Store version by creating its Game Center app version record. Everything Game Center knows about that release hangs off this record: use update_game_center_app_version to toggle it again, and add_compatibility_versions_to_game_center_app_version to keep earlier releases multiplayer compatible with it.

actions.name: create_game_center_challenge
actions.description: Create a Game Center challenge on the Game Center detail of one app or on a group, scored on one leaderboard. The challenge starts without a version; create its first version with create_game_center_challenge_version and add the localized text to that version.

actions.name: create_game_center_challenge_localization
actions.description: Add a locale with the name and description players see to a Game Center challenge version. App Store Connect rejects a locale the version already has.

actions.name: create_game_center_challenge_version
actions.description: Create a new version of a Game Center challenge, for example to change its localized text after the current version went live. The version starts empty; add its locales with create_game_center_challenge_localization.

actions.name: create_game_center_detail
actions.description: Enable Game Center for an app by creating its Game Center detail. The detail owns the achievements, leaderboards and leaderboard sets of the app, and an app has at most one of them.

actions.name: create_game_center_group
actions.description: Create a Game Center group. The group starts empty: an app joins it through its Game Center detail, and the achievements, leaderboards and leaderboard sets it shares are set with the replace actions.

actions.name: create_game_center_leaderboard
actions.description: Create a Game Center leaderboard owned by one app or shared by a group. App Store Connect always creates the first leaderboard version alongside it, so the player-facing text is added with create_game_center_leaderboard_localization against that version. Give recurrenceStartDate, recurrenceDuration and recurrenceRule together to make the leaderboard recurring.

actions.name: create_game_center_leaderboard_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to a Game Center leaderboard version with the name and score text players see there. The image shown next to the leaderboard is uploaded separately and is not covered by this connector.

actions.name: create_game_center_leaderboard_set
actions.description: Create a Game Center leaderboard set that groups related leaderboards under one entry in the Game Center dashboard, and optionally put existing leaderboards into it. App Store Connect always creates the first set version together with the set; add the localized set names with create_game_center_leaderboard_set_localization.

actions.name: create_game_center_leaderboard_set_localization
actions.description: Add a locale to a Game Center leaderboard set version with the set name players see in that locale. App Store Connect rejects a locale the version already has.

actions.name: create_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localization
actions.description: Give one leaderboard a name of its own inside one leaderboard set, for one locale. Without a member localization the leaderboard keeps its usual localized name inside the set.

actions.name: create_game_center_leaderboard_set_version
actions.description: Create a new editable version of a Game Center leaderboard set, for example to change its localized names after the current version went live.

actions.name: create_game_center_leaderboard_version
actions.description: Create a new version of a Game Center leaderboard so its localized text can be edited and taken through App Review again. Add the text with create_game_center_leaderboard_localization against the new version.

actions.name: create_game_center_matchmaking_queue
actions.description: Create a Game Center matchmaking queue and attach the rule set its requests are matched with. Optionally attach a second rule set to experiment with, and list the bundle identifiers whose classic matchmaking requests should reach this queue.

actions.name: create_game_center_matchmaking_rule
actions.description: Add a rule to a Game Center matchmaking rule set. The expression is evaluated for every candidate match: a COMPATIBLE, DISTANCE or TEAM rule decides whether the candidate is acceptable, and a MATCH rule scores it. Try the rule set with test_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set before attaching it to a queue.

actions.name: create_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set
actions.description: Create a Game Center matchmaking rule set with the player limits a match must stay within. Add its teams and rules afterwards with create_game_center_matchmaking_team and create_game_center_matchmaking_rule, then attach the rule set to a queue.

actions.name: create_game_center_matchmaking_team
actions.description: Add a team to a Game Center matchmaking rule set. Rule expressions refer to the team by its name, and Game Center fills the team with between minPlayers and maxPlayers players.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase
actions.description: Create an in-app purchase for an app. The product identifier is permanent and cannot be reused after deletion, so choose it carefully. The purchase starts in MISSING_METADATA until localizations, a price schedule, and a review screenshot are added.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_availability
actions.description: Set the territories an in-app purchase is sold in. The list replaces the current availability entirely, so territories left out are removed from sale.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_localization
actions.description: Add the display name and description of an in-app purchase for one locale. Each locale can have only one localization per purchase.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_offer_code
actions.description: Create an offer code configuration for an in-app purchase: who may redeem it and the discounted price per territory. Generate redeemable codes afterwards with the custom code or one-time-use code actions.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_offer_code_custom_code
actions.description: Create a custom code for an in-app purchase offer that customers redeem by typing it, with a redemption limit and optional expiration date.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_code
actions.description: Generate a batch of one-time-use codes for an in-app purchase offer. Download the generated code values from App Store Connect afterwards; they are not returned here.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_price_schedule
actions.description: Set the price schedule of an in-app purchase: a base territory plus manual prices for specific territories. Territories without a manual price get automatic prices equalized from the base territory. Posting a schedule replaces the prices App Store Connect currently has for the purchase.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_version
actions.description: Create a new metadata version of an in-app purchase so its display text and images can be edited and reviewed without taking the approved version off sale.

actions.name: create_in_app_purchase_version_localization
actions.description: Add the display name and description of an in-app purchase version for one locale.

actions.name: create_marketplace_search_detail
actions.description: Set the sitemap catalog URL of an alternative marketplace app so Apple can crawl it and include the marketplace apps in Spotlight search. Each marketplace app holds one search detail.

actions.name: create_merchant_id
actions.description: Register an Apple Pay merchant ID with the team. Payment processing and merchant identity certificates are issued for it afterwards with create_certificate.

actions.name: create_nomination
actions.description: Create a featuring nomination for one or more apps. With submitted false it stays a draft you can edit; with submitted true it is sent to Apple's editorial team right away.

actions.name: create_pass_type_id
actions.description: Register a Wallet pass type ID with the team. Pass signing certificates are issued for it afterwards with create_certificate.

actions.name: create_profile
actions.description: Create a provisioning profile for one bundle ID from the given certificates and, for development and ad hoc profiles, the devices allowed to install the app. App Store and in-house profile types take no devices.

actions.name: create_promoted_purchase
actions.description: Promote an in-app purchase or a subscription on the App Store product page of an app. Pass exactly one of inAppPurchaseId or subscriptionId. A promotional image must still be uploaded in App Store Connect before the promotion can be submitted.

actions.name: create_review_submission
actions.description: Start a new review submission for an app on one platform. Add items with add_review_submission_item, then send it with submit_review_submission. An app can have only one open submission per platform.

actions.name: create_subscription
actions.description: Create an auto-renewable subscription inside a subscription group. The product identifier cannot be changed afterwards, and the subscription still needs localizations, a price, availability, and a review submission before it can go on sale.

actions.name: create_subscription_group
actions.description: Create a subscription group for an app. Subscriptions are created inside a group, and customers can switch between the subscriptions of one group.

actions.name: create_subscription_group_localization
actions.description: Add the customer-facing name of a subscription group in one locale. Each locale can only be added once per group.

actions.name: create_subscription_group_version
actions.description: Create a new draft version of a subscription group so its localized names can be edited and submitted for review while the approved version stays live. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: create_subscription_group_version_localization
actions.description: Add the customer-facing name of a subscription group in one locale to a subscription group version. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: create_subscription_introductory_offer
actions.description: Create an introductory offer for an auto-renewable subscription. A FREE_TRIAL offer needs no price point; PAY_AS_YOU_GO and PAY_UP_FRONT offers need the subscription price point of the territory. Apple allows one active introductory offer per territory at a time. Sandbox may take up to an hour to reflect the change.

actions.name: create_subscription_localization
actions.description: Add the customer-facing name and description of a subscription in one locale. Each locale can only be added once per subscription.

actions.name: create_subscription_offer_code
actions.description: Create an offer code configuration for an auto-renewable subscription together with its territory prices. Generate the redeemable codes afterwards with create_subscription_offer_code_custom_code or create_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code.

actions.name: create_subscription_offer_code_custom_code
actions.description: Generate a custom code for an offer code configuration, which many customers can redeem up to the given number of times. The code text cannot be changed once created.

actions.name: create_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code
actions.description: Generate a batch of one-time use codes for an offer code configuration. Each code can be redeemed once; download the code values from App Store Connect afterwards.

actions.name: create_subscription_plan_availability
actions.description: Make one payment plan of a subscription available in a set of territories. Each plan type can only have one availability record per subscription; use update_subscription_plan_availability to change an existing one.

actions.name: create_subscription_price
actions.description: Set the price of a subscription in one territory from a subscription price point, either as the initial price or as a scheduled price change. Use list_subscription_price_points to find the price point identifier. A scheduled change can be removed again with delete_subscription_price.

actions.name: create_subscription_promotional_offer
actions.description: Create a promotional offer for an auto-renewable subscription together with its territory prices. The offer code becomes the identifier your app passes to StoreKit and cannot be changed later.

actions.name: create_subscription_version
actions.description: Create a new draft version of a subscription so its localized metadata can be edited and submitted for review while the approved version stays live. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: create_subscription_version_localization
actions.description: Add the customer-facing name and description of a subscription in one locale to a subscription version. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: create_webhook
actions.description: Register a webhook on an app so App Store Connect posts a signed notification to the URL whenever one of the chosen events happens. Use ping_webhook afterwards to test the endpoint.

actions.name: create_win_back_offer
actions.description: Create a win-back offer for lapsed subscribers of an auto-renewable subscription together with its prices, one subscription price point per territory. The offer identifier, duration, mode, and period count cannot be changed later.

actions.name: delete_accessibility_declaration
actions.description: Delete an accessibility declaration.

actions.name: delete_alternative_distribution_domain
actions.description: Delete an alternative distribution domain. Apps served from that domain can no longer be installed through it.

actions.name: delete_alternative_distribution_key
actions.description: Remove an alternative distribution key from the account. Tokens signed with the matching private key stop being accepted.

actions.name: delete_analytics_report_request
actions.description: Delete an analytics report request. App Store Connect stops producing its reports and the existing report instances are no longer listed.

actions.name: delete_android_to_ios_app_mapping_detail
actions.description: Delete an Android app mapping.

actions.name: delete_app_clip_advanced_experience
actions.description: Delete an advanced App Clip experience. App Store Connect has no DELETE endpoint for it; the experience is removed by setting its documented removed flag, after which users can no longer invoke it.

actions.name: delete_app_clip_default_experience
actions.description: Delete a default App Clip experience together with its localizations and review detail.

actions.name: delete_app_clip_default_experience_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from a default App Clip experience together with its header image.

actions.name: delete_app_custom_product_page
actions.description: Delete a custom product page together with all of its versions and localizations. Its App Store URL stops working.

actions.name: delete_app_custom_product_page_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from a custom product page version, including the screenshots and previews attached to it.

actions.name: delete_app_event
actions.description: Delete an in-app event together with its localizations. A published event is removed from the App Store.

actions.name: delete_app_event_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from an in-app event together with the screenshots and video clips uploaded for it.

actions.name: delete_app_info_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from an app info record. The app stops being listed in that language once the change is submitted.

actions.name: delete_app_store_version
actions.description: Delete an App Store version that has not been submitted yet, together with its localizations and review information.

actions.name: delete_app_store_version_experiment
actions.description: Delete a product page optimization test together with its treatments. A running test is stopped; results already collected are lost.

actions.name: delete_app_store_version_experiment_treatment
actions.description: Delete a treatment from a product page optimization test, including its localizations and screenshots.

actions.name: delete_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from a treatment, including the screenshots and previews attached to it.

actions.name: delete_app_store_version_localization
actions.description: Remove the App Store metadata of one locale from an App Store version, including its screenshots and previews.

actions.name: delete_app_store_version_phased_release
actions.description: Turn off phased release for an App Store version so the approved update reaches every user at once.

actions.name: delete_beta_app_clip_invocation
actions.description: Delete a TestFlight App Clip invocation and its localized titles. Testers can no longer launch that experience from TestFlight.

actions.name: delete_beta_app_clip_invocation_localization
actions.description: Delete one localized title of a TestFlight App Clip invocation.

actions.name: delete_beta_app_localization
actions.description: Delete the TestFlight test information of an app in one locale. Testers in that locale fall back to the primary locale.

actions.name: delete_beta_build_localization
actions.description: Delete the "What to Test" notes of one build in one locale. Testers in that locale fall back to the notes of the primary locale.

actions.name: delete_beta_feedback_crash_submission
actions.description: Delete a crash feedback submission from App Store Connect. The crash log and comment are removed permanently.

actions.name: delete_beta_feedback_screenshot_submission
actions.description: Delete a screenshot feedback submission from App Store Connect. The screenshots and comment are removed permanently.

actions.name: delete_beta_group
actions.description: Delete a TestFlight group. Testers who only belonged to that group lose access to its builds.

actions.name: delete_beta_recruitment_criterion
actions.description: Delete the recruitment criteria of a TestFlight group, so anyone with the public link can join again.

actions.name: delete_beta_tester
actions.description: Remove a TestFlight tester from the team, revoking their access to every build and group.

actions.name: delete_bundle_id
actions.description: Delete a bundle ID from the team. App Store Connect refuses to delete a bundle ID that an app record still uses.

actions.name: delete_ci_product
actions.description: Delete an Xcode Cloud product, which removes every workflow and build history of that app or framework from Xcode Cloud.

actions.name: delete_ci_workflow
actions.description: Delete an Xcode Cloud workflow together with its build history. Builds already delivered to TestFlight or App Store Connect are kept.

actions.name: delete_customer_review_response
actions.description: Remove a published developer response from an App Store review.

actions.name: delete_end_user_license_agreement
actions.description: Remove the custom end user license agreement of an app so Apple's standard EULA applies in every territory.

actions.name: delete_game_center_achievement
actions.description: Delete a Game Center achievement together with all of its versions and localizations. Players lose the achievement and the progress recorded for it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_achievement_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from a Game Center achievement version, including the achievement image uploaded for it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_activity
actions.description: Delete a Game Center activity together with its versions, localizations and images. Archive it with update_game_center_activity instead when players may still hold invitations to it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_activity_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from a Game Center activity version, including the image attached to it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_challenge
actions.description: Delete a Game Center challenge together with all of its versions, localizations and images.

actions.name: delete_game_center_challenge_localization
actions.description: Remove one locale from a Game Center challenge version, including the image attached to it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_group
actions.description: Delete a Game Center group. The apps that were in the group keep their own Game Center records and stop sharing progress with each other.

actions.name: delete_game_center_leaderboard
actions.description: Delete a Game Center leaderboard together with its versions, localizations and the scores players submitted to it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_leaderboard_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from a Game Center leaderboard version, including the image uploaded for it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_leaderboard_set
actions.description: Delete a Game Center leaderboard set together with its versions and localizations. The leaderboards that were in the set are kept and stay available on their own.

actions.name: delete_game_center_leaderboard_set_localization
actions.description: Remove a locale from a Game Center leaderboard set version, including the image uploaded for that locale.

actions.name: delete_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localization
actions.description: Delete the name a leaderboard is shown under inside a leaderboard set for one locale. The leaderboard stays in the set and falls back to its usual localized name.

actions.name: delete_game_center_matchmaking_queue
actions.description: Delete a Game Center matchmaking queue. Requests the game sends to the deleted queue are no longer matched.

actions.name: delete_game_center_matchmaking_rule
actions.description: Delete a rule from its Game Center matchmaking rule set. Candidate matches are no longer checked against it.

actions.name: delete_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set
actions.description: Delete a Game Center matchmaking rule set together with its teams and rules. A queue that still points at the rule set stops matching requests.

actions.name: delete_game_center_matchmaking_team
actions.description: Delete a team from its Game Center matchmaking rule set. Rule expressions that still refer to the team by name stop working.

actions.name: delete_in_app_purchase
actions.description: Delete an in-app purchase that has never been approved. Its product identifier can never be used again for this app.

actions.name: delete_in_app_purchase_localization
actions.description: Delete one locale of an in-app purchase's display name and description.

actions.name: delete_in_app_purchase_version_localization
actions.description: Delete one locale from an in-app purchase version.

actions.name: delete_marketplace_search_detail
actions.description: Delete the marketplace search detail of an alternative marketplace app. Apple stops crawling the catalog URL.

actions.name: delete_merchant_id
actions.description: Delete an Apple Pay merchant ID from the team. Apple Pay transactions and certificates that reference it stop working.

actions.name: delete_nomination
actions.description: Delete a featuring nomination.

actions.name: delete_pass_type_id
actions.description: Delete a Wallet pass type ID from the team. Passes signed for it can no longer be updated and its certificates stop working.

actions.name: delete_profile
actions.description: Delete a provisioning profile so it can no longer be downloaded or used to sign new builds. Create a replacement with create_profile when the bundle ID still needs one.

actions.name: delete_promoted_purchase
actions.description: Remove a promotion from the App Store product page of an app.

actions.name: delete_review_submission_item
actions.description: Delete an item from a review submission that has not been sent to App Review yet.

actions.name: delete_subscription
actions.description: Delete an auto-renewable subscription. App Store Connect only deletes subscriptions that have never been approved; approved subscriptions can only be removed from sale.

actions.name: delete_subscription_group
actions.description: Delete a subscription group. App Store Connect only deletes groups that no longer contain subscriptions that have been approved.

actions.name: delete_subscription_group_localization
actions.description: Delete the customer-facing name of a subscription group in one locale.

actions.name: delete_subscription_group_version_localization
actions.description: Delete one localization from a subscription group version. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: delete_subscription_introductory_offer
actions.description: Delete an introductory offer. Customers who already redeemed it keep their discounted period.

actions.name: delete_subscription_localization
actions.description: Delete the customer-facing name and description of a subscription in one locale.

actions.name: delete_subscription_price
actions.description: Delete a scheduled price change of a subscription before it takes effect. The price that is already in effect cannot be deleted.

actions.name: delete_subscription_promotional_offer
actions.description: Delete a promotional offer. Apps can no longer present it, and customers who already redeemed it keep their discounted period.

actions.name: delete_subscription_version_localization
actions.description: Delete one localization from a subscription version. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Remove a member from the App Store Connect team. They lose access to every app and to any API keys tied to their account.

actions.name: delete_webhook
actions.description: Delete a webhook. App Store Connect stops sending notifications to its URL and its delivery history is no longer reachable.

actions.name: delete_win_back_offer
actions.description: Delete a win-back offer. Apps can no longer present it, and customers who already redeemed it keep their discounted period.

actions.name: disable_bundle_id_capability
actions.description: Disable a capability on a bundle ID and discard its configuration. Provisioning profiles that relied on the capability become invalid.

actions.name: enable_bundle_id_capability
actions.description: Enable a capability such as push notifications or associated domains on a bundle ID. Provisioning profiles created for the bundle ID before the change may need to be regenerated to carry the new entitlement.

actions.name: get_accessibility_declaration
actions.description: Read one accessibility declaration by its identifier.

actions.name: get_actor
actions.description: Read one audit-log actor by identifier.

actions.name: get_age_rating_declaration
actions.description: Read the age rating questionnaire answers attached to an app info record, including any manual rating overrides.

actions.name: get_alternative_distribution_domain
actions.description: Read one alternative distribution domain.

actions.name: get_alternative_distribution_key
actions.description: Read one alternative distribution key and its public key.

actions.name: get_alternative_distribution_package
actions.description: Read one alternative distribution package and the checksums of the source build it was generated from. Use list_alternative_distribution_package_versions for its downloadable versions.

actions.name: get_alternative_distribution_package_delta
actions.description: Read one delta update of an alternative distribution package version, with its download URL and encrypted key blob.

actions.name: get_alternative_distribution_package_variant
actions.description: Read one variant of an alternative distribution package version, with its download URL and encrypted key blob.

actions.name: get_alternative_distribution_package_version
actions.description: Read one alternative distribution package version and its time-limited download URL.

actions.name: get_analytics_report
actions.description: Read one analytics report type by identifier.

actions.name: get_analytics_report_instance
actions.description: Read one analytics report instance by identifier.

actions.name: get_analytics_report_request
actions.description: Read one analytics report request by identifier.

actions.name: get_android_to_ios_app_mapping_detail
actions.description: Read one Android app mapping by its identifier.

actions.name: get_app
actions.description: Read one app record by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_app_alternative_distribution_key
actions.description: Read the alternative distribution key tied to one app, or null when the app has no key of its own.

actions.name: get_app_availability
actions.description: Read the availability configuration of an app, which says whether it is automatically offered in new territories. Returns null when App Store Connect has no availability record for the app yet. Use list_territory_availabilities for the per-territory settings.

actions.name: get_app_beta_tester_usages
actions.description: Read TestFlight usage metrics for one app: sessions, crashes, and feedback over the chosen period, either as one aggregate row or as one row per tester.

actions.name: get_app_category
actions.description: Read one App Store category with its platforms, parent category, and subcategory identifiers.

actions.name: get_app_clip
actions.description: Read one App Clip by its identifier.

actions.name: get_app_clip_advanced_experience
actions.description: Read one advanced App Clip experience with its invocation URL, place, status, and localized card text.

actions.name: get_app_clip_default_experience
actions.description: Read one default App Clip experience with its action and the App Store version it is released with.

actions.name: get_app_clip_default_experience_localization
actions.description: Read one default App Clip experience localization by its identifier.

actions.name: get_app_clip_default_experience_review_detail
actions.description: Read the invocation URLs App Review uses to test a default App Clip experience, or null when none were provided yet.

actions.name: get_app_custom_product_page
actions.description: Read one custom product page by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_app_custom_product_page_localization
actions.description: Read one custom product page localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_app_custom_product_page_version
actions.description: Read one custom product page version by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_app_encryption_declaration
actions.description: Read one export compliance (encryption) declaration by its identifier.

actions.name: get_app_event
actions.description: Read one in-app event with its state, badge, purpose, and territory schedules.

actions.name: get_app_event_localization
actions.description: Read one in-app event localization by its identifier.

actions.name: get_app_game_center_detail
actions.description: Read the Game Center configuration of one app, including the group it belongs to and the leaderboards shown by default. Returns null when the app has never been enabled for Game Center.

actions.name: get_app_info
actions.description: Read one app info record with its review state, derived age ratings, and App Store category identifiers.

actions.name: get_app_info_localization
actions.description: Read one app info localization by its identifier.

actions.name: get_app_perf_power_metrics
actions.description: Fetch the performance and power metrics of the most recent versions of an app, such as launch time, hang rate, memory, and battery use, in the xcodeMetrics document format. Use get_build_perf_power_metrics for one specific build.

actions.name: get_app_price_point
actions.description: Read one price point by its App Store Connect identifier, including the territory it belongs to.

actions.name: get_app_price_schedule
actions.description: Read the price schedule of an app, including the base territory its automatic prices derive from. Returns null when App Store Connect has no price schedule for the app yet. Use list_app_price_schedule_manual_prices and list_app_price_schedule_automatic_prices for the individual prices.

actions.name: get_app_price_schedule_base_territory
actions.description: Read the base territory of a price schedule, the territory whose price the automatic prices of the other territories are derived from.

actions.name: get_app_store_review_detail
actions.description: Read the App Review contact details, demo account, and notes attached to an App Store version, or null when none were entered yet.

actions.name: get_app_store_version
actions.description: Read one App Store version by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_alternative_distribution_package
actions.description: Read the alternative distribution package generated for one App Store version, or null when none exists yet.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_build
actions.description: Read the build currently attached to an App Store version, or null when no build has been selected.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_experiment
actions.description: Read one product page optimization test, including the App Store version that serves as its control.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_experiment_treatment
actions.description: Read one treatment of a product page optimization test.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization
actions.description: Read one treatment localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_game_center_app_version
actions.description: Read the Game Center app version of one App Store version. Returns null when Game Center was never enabled for that version.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_localization
actions.description: Read the localized App Store metadata of one version in one locale.

actions.name: get_app_store_version_phased_release
actions.description: Read the phased release configuration of an App Store version, or null when phased release is not configured for it.

actions.name: get_background_asset
actions.description: Read one background asset pack, with the version currently in each of the App Store, internal TestFlight, and external TestFlight slots.

actions.name: get_background_asset_version
actions.description: Read one background asset version with its processing state, validation messages, parent asset pack, and release records.

actions.name: get_background_asset_version_app_store_release
actions.description: Read the App Store release record of a background asset version, which tracks its App Review and distribution state.

actions.name: get_background_asset_version_external_beta_release
actions.description: Read the external TestFlight release record of a background asset version, which tracks its beta review state.

actions.name: get_background_asset_version_internal_beta_release
actions.description: Read the internal TestFlight release record of a background asset version. App Store Connect creates it once the version finishes processing.

actions.name: get_beta_app_clip_invocation
actions.description: Read one TestFlight App Clip invocation together with its localized titles.

actions.name: get_beta_app_localization
actions.description: Read the TestFlight test information of one app and locale by its identifier.

actions.name: get_beta_app_review_detail
actions.description: Read the contact person, demo account, and notes Apple uses when reviewing an app for TestFlight external testing.

actions.name: get_beta_app_review_submission
actions.description: Read one TestFlight beta review submission by its identifier.

actions.name: get_beta_build_localization
actions.description: Read the "What to Test" notes record of one build and locale by its identifier.

actions.name: get_beta_feedback_crash_log
actions.description: Read the full crash log text attached to one crash feedback submission.

actions.name: get_beta_feedback_crash_submission
actions.description: Read one crash feedback submission with its device details and the build and tester it came from.

actions.name: get_beta_feedback_screenshot_submission
actions.description: Read one screenshot feedback submission with its device details, attached screenshots, and the build and tester it came from.

actions.name: get_beta_group
actions.description: Read one TestFlight group by its identifier, including its public link settings.

actions.name: get_beta_group_beta_tester_usages
actions.description: Read TestFlight usage metrics for one group: sessions, crashes, and feedback over the chosen period, either as one aggregate row or as one row per tester.

actions.name: get_beta_license_agreement
actions.description: Read the license agreement TestFlight testers of an app must accept.

actions.name: get_beta_recruitment_criterion
actions.description: Read the recruitment criteria of a TestFlight group, which restrict who can join through its public link by device family and OS version. Returns null when the group has no criteria.

actions.name: get_beta_recruitment_criterion_compatible_build_check
actions.description: Check whether a TestFlight group has a build that testers matching its recruitment criteria could install.

actions.name: get_beta_tester
actions.description: Read one TestFlight tester by its identifier, including the invitation state and the devices the app is installed on.

actions.name: get_beta_tester_usages
actions.description: Read TestFlight usage metrics of one tester in one app: sessions, crashes, and feedback over the chosen period.

actions.name: get_build
actions.description: Read one build together with its prerelease version, its TestFlight review submission, and the app it belongs to.

actions.name: get_build_beta_build_usages
actions.description: Read TestFlight usage metrics of one build: invitations, installs, sessions, crashes, and feedback since the build became available.

actions.name: get_build_beta_detail
actions.description: Read the TestFlight distribution details of one build: its internal and external testing states and whether testers are notified automatically.

actions.name: get_build_bundle_app_clip_domain_cache_status
actions.description: Read the cached validation status of the associated domains an App Clip build bundle declares, as Apple's CDN last recorded it. Returns null when App Store Connect has no status for the bundle.

actions.name: get_build_bundle_app_clip_domain_debug_status
actions.description: Read the debug-mode validation status of the associated domains an App Clip build bundle declares, which checks the domains directly instead of Apple's CDN cache. Returns null when App Store Connect has no status for the bundle.

actions.name: get_build_perf_power_metrics
actions.description: Fetch the performance and power metrics collected for one build in the xcodeMetrics document format.

actions.name: get_bundle_id
actions.description: Read one bundle ID record by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_bundle_id_app
actions.description: Read the App Store Connect app that uses one bundle ID. Returns null when no app has been created for the bundle ID yet.

actions.name: get_certificate
actions.description: Read one certificate by its App Store Connect identifier, including its base64 DER content.

actions.name: get_ci_artifact
actions.description: Read one build artifact, including a fresh time-limited download URL for its file.

actions.name: get_ci_build_action
actions.description: Read one action of a build run, with its progress, outcome, and issue counts.

actions.name: get_ci_build_action_build_run
actions.description: Read the build run a build action belongs to.

actions.name: get_ci_build_run
actions.description: Read one Xcode Cloud build run, including its progress, completion status, issue counts, and the commit it built. Poll it to follow a run started with start_ci_build_run.

actions.name: get_ci_issue
actions.description: Read one issue a build action reported, with the file and line it points at.

actions.name: get_ci_mac_os_version
actions.description: Read one macOS version available in Xcode Cloud.

actions.name: get_ci_product
actions.description: Read one Xcode Cloud product by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_ci_test_result
actions.description: Read the result of one test method across the destinations it ran on.

actions.name: get_ci_workflow
actions.description: Read one Xcode Cloud workflow with its start conditions, actions, and the product, repository, Xcode version, and macOS version it uses.

actions.name: get_ci_workflow_repository
actions.description: Read the source repository an Xcode Cloud workflow builds from.

actions.name: get_ci_xcode_version
actions.description: Read one Xcode version available in Xcode Cloud, with the simulators and Macs available for tests.

actions.name: get_customer_review
actions.description: Read one App Store review together with the developer response published for it.

actions.name: get_device
actions.description: Read one registered device by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_diagnostic_signature_logs
actions.description: Fetch the anonymized backtrace logs App Store Connect recorded for one diagnostic signature, including call stack trees and device metadata.

actions.name: get_end_user_license_agreement
actions.description: Read the custom end user license agreement of an app together with the territories it applies in. Returns null when the app uses Apple's standard EULA everywhere.

actions.name: get_game_center_achievement
actions.description: Read one Game Center achievement by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_achievement_localization
actions.description: Read one Game Center achievement localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_achievement_localization_image
actions.description: Read the achievement image uploaded for one Game Center achievement localization, including its delivery state, or null when no image has been uploaded. Uploading an image is not covered by this connector; only the already uploaded image can be read.

actions.name: get_game_center_achievement_version
actions.description: Read one Game Center achievement version by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_activity
actions.description: Read one Game Center activity by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_activity_localization
actions.description: Read one Game Center activity localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_activity_localization_image
actions.description: Read the image of one Game Center activity localization. Returns null when the locale has no image of its own and falls back to the default image of the version; uploading an image is not covered by this connector.

actions.name: get_game_center_activity_version
actions.description: Read one Game Center activity version by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_activity_version_default_image
actions.description: Read the default image of a Game Center activity version, shown wherever a locale has no image of its own. Returns null when no default image has been uploaded yet; uploading one is not covered by this connector.

actions.name: get_game_center_app_version
actions.description: Read one Game Center app version by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_app_version_app_store_version
actions.description: Read the App Store version a Game Center app version belongs to, for example to learn its version string and review state.

actions.name: get_game_center_challenge
actions.description: Read one Game Center challenge by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_challenge_localization
actions.description: Read one Game Center challenge localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_challenge_localization_image
actions.description: Read the image of one Game Center challenge localization, or null when the locale has no image of its own and falls back to the default image of the version. Uploading an image is not covered by this connector.

actions.name: get_game_center_challenge_version
actions.description: Read one Game Center challenge version by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_challenge_version_default_image
actions.description: Read the default image of a Game Center challenge version, the one shown for locales without their own image. Returns null when the version has no default image. Uploading an image is not covered by this connector.

actions.name: get_game_center_classic_matchmaking_request_metrics
actions.description: Read the matchmaking requests an app made through classic (non rule based) matchmaking, as time series of request counts and queue wait times. Each data point covers the granularity you pass.

actions.name: get_game_center_detail
actions.description: Read one Game Center detail by its App Store Connect identifier, together with the group and the default leaderboards it links to.

actions.name: get_game_center_detail_group
actions.description: Read the Game Center group a Game Center detail belongs to. Returns null when the app does not share its achievements and leaderboards with other apps.

actions.name: get_game_center_group
actions.description: Read one Game Center group by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard
actions.description: Read one Game Center leaderboard by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard_localization
actions.description: Read one Game Center leaderboard localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard_localization_image
actions.description: Read the image shown with a Game Center leaderboard localization, including its delivery state. Returns null when no image has been uploaded for the locale. Uploading an image is not covered by this connector, only reading the one already uploaded.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard_set
actions.description: Read one Game Center leaderboard set by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard_set_localization
actions.description: Read one Game Center leaderboard set localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard_set_localization_image
actions.description: Read the image attached to one Game Center leaderboard set localization, with its delivery URL and upload state. Uploading an image is not covered by this connector; only an image that was already uploaded can be read.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard_set_version
actions.description: Read one Game Center leaderboard set version by its App Store Connect identifier, including its review state.

actions.name: get_game_center_leaderboard_version
actions.description: Read one Game Center leaderboard version by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_queue
actions.description: Read one Game Center matchmaking queue by its App Store Connect identifier, including the rule set it matches requests with and the rule set of a running experiment.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_queue_experiment_request_metrics
actions.description: Read the share of a queue's traffic that was matched with the experiment rule set, as time series of request counts and queue wait times. Compare it with get_game_center_matchmaking_queue_request_metrics to judge whether the experiment rule set is an improvement.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_queue_experiment_size_metrics
actions.description: Read how many requests were waiting in the part of a matchmaking queue served by the experiment rule set, as time series of average and percentile queue sizes.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_queue_request_metrics
actions.description: Read the matchmaking requests one queue handled, as time series of request counts and queue wait times, optionally split by result or by the app that sent the requests.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_queue_session_metrics
actions.description: Read the matchmaking sessions one queue produced, as time series of session counts and of how many players each session held.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_queue_size_metrics
actions.description: Read how many requests were waiting in one matchmaking queue, as time series of average and percentile queue sizes.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_rule_boolean_result_metrics
actions.description: Read how often one matchmaking rule returned each boolean result, as time series of evaluation counts.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_rule_error_metrics
actions.description: Read how often one matchmaking rule failed to evaluate, as time series of error counts.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_rule_number_result_metrics
actions.description: Read the values one matchmaking rule expression returned, as time series of evaluation counts with average and percentile results.

actions.name: get_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set
actions.description: Read one Game Center matchmaking rule set by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_game_center_rule_based_matchmaking_request_metrics
actions.description: Read the matchmaking requests an app made through rule based matchmaking, as time series of request counts and queue wait times.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase
actions.description: Read one in-app purchase by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_availability
actions.description: Read the availability record of an in-app purchase, which says whether it is offered in new territories automatically. Returns null when no availability has been set. Use list_in_app_purchase_available_territories for the territory list.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_content
actions.description: Read the metadata and temporary download URL of the hosted content package of an in-app purchase. Returns null when no content has been uploaded.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_localization
actions.description: Read one in-app purchase localization by its identifier.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_offer_code
actions.description: Read one in-app purchase offer code configuration by its identifier.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_price_schedule
actions.description: Read the price schedule of an in-app purchase together with its base territory. Returns null when the purchase has no price schedule yet.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_price_schedule_base_territory
actions.description: Read the base territory of an in-app purchase price schedule, including its currency.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_version
actions.description: Read one in-app purchase version by its identifier.

actions.name: get_in_app_purchase_version_localization
actions.description: Read one localization of an in-app purchase version by its identifier.

actions.name: get_marketplace_search_detail
actions.description: Read the marketplace search detail of an alternative marketplace app, or null when no catalog URL has been configured.

actions.name: get_merchant_id
actions.description: Read one Apple Pay merchant ID record by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_nomination
actions.description: Read one featuring nomination by its identifier.

actions.name: get_pass_type_id
actions.description: Read one Wallet pass type ID record by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_pre_release_version
actions.description: Read one prerelease version by its identifier.

actions.name: get_profile
actions.description: Read one provisioning profile by its App Store Connect identifier, including its base64 content.

actions.name: get_profile_bundle_id
actions.description: Read the bundle ID a provisioning profile was created for.

actions.name: get_promoted_purchase
actions.description: Read one promoted purchase by its identifier.

actions.name: get_review_submission
actions.description: Read one review submission with its state and the App Store version it carries.

actions.name: get_scm_git_reference
actions.description: Read one branch or tag of a repository as Xcode Cloud sees it.

actions.name: get_scm_provider
actions.description: Read one source control provider connected to Xcode Cloud.

actions.name: get_scm_pull_request
actions.description: Read one pull request of a repository as Xcode Cloud sees it.

actions.name: get_scm_repository
actions.description: Read one source repository, with its provider and default branch identifiers.

actions.name: get_subscription
actions.description: Read one auto-renewable subscription by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_grace_period
actions.description: Read the billing grace period settings of an app, either by app or by the grace period record identifier. Pass exactly one of appId or subscriptionGracePeriodId.

actions.name: get_subscription_group
actions.description: Read one subscription group by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_group_localization
actions.description: Read one subscription group localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_group_version
actions.description: Read one subscription group version by its App Store Connect identifier. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: get_subscription_group_version_localization
actions.description: Read one subscription group version localization by its App Store Connect identifier. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: get_subscription_localization
actions.description: Read one subscription localization by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_offer_code
actions.description: Read one offer code configuration by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_offer_code_custom_code
actions.description: Read one custom code batch by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code
actions.description: Read one one-time use code batch by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_plan_availability
actions.description: Read one subscription plan availability by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_price_point
actions.description: Read one subscription price point by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_promotional_offer
actions.description: Read one promotional offer by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_subscription_version
actions.description: Read one subscription version by its App Store Connect identifier. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: get_subscription_version_localization
actions.description: Read one subscription version localization by its App Store Connect identifier. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: get_user
actions.description: Read one App Store Connect team member by identifier.

actions.name: get_user_invitation
actions.description: Read one pending team invitation by identifier.

actions.name: get_webhook
actions.description: Read one webhook by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: get_win_back_offer
actions.description: Read one win-back offer by its App Store Connect identifier.

actions.name: invite_user
actions.description: Invite someone to join the App Store Connect team with the given roles. Apple emails them an activation link that expires after three days; the invitation can be cancelled until it is accepted.

actions.name: list_accessibility_declarations
actions.description: List the accessibility declarations (Accessibility Nutrition Labels) of an app, optionally filtered by device family or publication state.

actions.name: list_actors
actions.description: Resolve audit-log actor identifiers, such as the submitter of a review submission, to the team member, API key, or system that performed the action. App Store Connect requires at least one identifier.

actions.name: list_alternative_distribution_domains
actions.description: List the base web domains registered for alternative distribution on the account.

actions.name: list_alternative_distribution_keys
actions.description: List the alternative distribution public keys of the team. A key without an app applies to every alternative distribution app on the account.

actions.name: list_alternative_distribution_package_version_deltas
actions.description: List the delta updates of an alternative distribution package version, each with its download URL and encrypted key blob.

actions.name: list_alternative_distribution_package_version_variants
