actions.description: List the device-specific variants of an alternative distribution package version, each with its download URL and encrypted key blob.

actions.name: list_alternative_distribution_package_versions
actions.description: List the versions of an alternative distribution package with their time-limited download URLs.

actions.name: list_analytics_report_instances
actions.description: List the processed instances of one analytics report, each covering a daily, weekly, or monthly period.

actions.name: list_analytics_report_requests
actions.description: List the analytics report requests of one app, which are the entry point to its analytics reports.

actions.name: list_analytics_report_segments
actions.description: List the downloadable segments of one analytics report instance. Each url points at a gzip-compressed file that the caller downloads itself; the links expire five minutes after they are issued, so call this action right before downloading.

actions.name: list_analytics_reports
actions.description: List the report types available under one analytics report request, optionally narrowed by category or exact name.

actions.name: list_android_to_ios_app_mapping_details
actions.description: List the Android app mappings of an app, which link an Android package to this app for Android to iPhone migration.

actions.name: list_app_categories
actions.description: List App Store categories with their platforms, parent, and subcategory identifiers. Filter by platform or list only top-level categories or only subcategories.

actions.name: list_app_clip_advanced_experiences
actions.description: List the advanced experiences of an App Clip with their localized card text. Filter by status, place match status, or action.

actions.name: list_app_clip_default_experience_localizations
actions.description: List the localized subtitles of a default App Clip experience, optionally narrowed to some locales.

actions.name: list_app_clip_default_experiences
actions.description: List the default experiences of an App Clip with the App Store version each one is released with. Optionally keep only experiences that are, or are not, attached to a version.

actions.name: list_app_clips
actions.description: List the App Clips of an app, optionally filtered by bundle identifier.

actions.name: list_app_custom_product_page_localizations
actions.description: List the localizations of one custom product page version, optionally narrowed to some locales.

actions.name: list_app_custom_product_page_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one custom product page, optionally narrowed to some review states.

actions.name: list_app_custom_product_pages
actions.description: List the custom product pages of one app, optionally only the visible or only the hidden ones.

actions.name: list_app_encryption_declarations
actions.description: List the export compliance (encryption) declarations of an app with their review state and compliance code, optionally filtered by platform or by the builds they cover.

actions.name: list_app_event_localizations
actions.description: List the localized name and descriptions of an in-app event for every locale.

actions.name: list_app_events
actions.description: List the in-app events of an app, optionally narrowed to some review states or identifiers.

actions.name: list_app_info_localizations
actions.description: List the localized names, subtitles, and privacy URLs of an app info record, optionally narrowed to some locales.

actions.name: list_app_infos
actions.description: List the app info records of an app, each with its review state, derived age ratings, and the identifiers of its App Store categories. An app usually has one editable record plus the record of the version on the App Store.

actions.name: list_app_price_point_equalizations
actions.description: List the price points in other territories that App Store Connect considers equivalent to one price point, optionally narrowed to some territories. Use it to pick matching manual prices across territories.

actions.name: list_app_price_points
actions.description: List the price points an app can be sold at, optionally narrowed to some territories. Each price point carries the customer price and developer proceeds in the territory currency; pass its identifier to create_app_price_schedule.

actions.name: list_app_price_schedule_automatic_prices
actions.description: List the automatic prices of a price schedule, which App Store Connect derives from the base territory price for every territory without a manual price. Each entry carries its price point, territory, customer price and proceeds.

actions.name: list_app_price_schedule_manual_prices
actions.description: List the manual prices of a price schedule, each with the price point it uses, the territory it applies to and the customer price and proceeds of that price point.

actions.name: list_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localizations
actions.description: List the locales of one treatment, optionally narrowed to some locales. Screenshots and previews of a treatment are attached to these localizations.

actions.name: list_app_store_version_experiment_treatments
actions.description: List the treatments of one product page optimization test.

actions.name: list_app_store_version_experiments
actions.description: List the product page optimization tests of one app, optionally narrowed to some states, with the App Store version each test uses as its control.

actions.name: list_app_store_version_localizations
actions.description: List the localized App Store metadata (description, keywords, release notes, URLs) of one App Store version, optionally narrowed to specific locales.

actions.name: list_app_store_versions
actions.description: List the App Store versions of one app, with the review and release state of each version.

actions.name: list_app_tags
actions.description: List the tags App Store Connect assigned to an app for App Store discovery, optionally only those shown or hidden on the App Store.

actions.name: list_apps
actions.description: List the apps the API key can see, optionally filtered by bundle identifier, name, or SKU.

actions.name: list_background_asset_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one background asset pack with their processing state and their internal TestFlight, external TestFlight, and App Store release records.

actions.name: list_background_assets
actions.description: List the Apple-hosted background asset packs of one app, with the version currently in each of the App Store, internal TestFlight, and external TestFlight slots.

actions.name: list_beta_app_clip_invocations
actions.description: List the App Clip invocations testers can launch from TestFlight for one App Clip build bundle, with the localized titles of each. Find build bundle identifiers with list_build_bundles.

actions.name: list_beta_app_localizations
actions.description: List the TestFlight test information of one app, one record per locale, optionally narrowed to a single locale.

actions.name: list_beta_app_review_submissions
actions.description: List the TestFlight beta review submissions of one build, optionally narrowed to one review state.

actions.name: list_beta_build_localizations
actions.description: List the "What to Test" notes of one build, one record per locale, optionally narrowed to a single locale.

actions.name: list_beta_feedback_crash_submissions
actions.description: List the crash feedback testers sent from TestFlight for one app, with the build and tester each submission came from. Use get_beta_feedback_crash_log to read the crash log text of one submission.

actions.name: list_beta_feedback_screenshot_submissions
actions.description: List the screenshot feedback testers sent from TestFlight for one app, with the build and tester each submission came from. Screenshot download URLs expire, so fetch them soon after listing.

actions.name: list_beta_group_builds
actions.description: List the builds one TestFlight group can install, with the prerelease version each build belongs to.

actions.name: list_beta_groups
actions.description: List the TestFlight groups of one app, including the public invitation link of each group.

actions.name: list_beta_recruitment_criterion_options
actions.description: List the device families and OS versions App Store Connect accepts in recruitment criteria, to pick valid minimumOsInclusive and maximumOsInclusive values.

actions.name: list_beta_tester_apps
actions.description: List the apps one TestFlight tester has access to.

actions.name: list_beta_tester_beta_groups
actions.description: List the TestFlight groups one tester belongs to.

actions.name: list_beta_testers
actions.description: List TestFlight testers, optionally narrowed to one app, group, or build.

actions.name: list_build_beta_groups
actions.description: List the TestFlight groups that can install one build.

actions.name: list_build_bundle_file_sizes
actions.description: List the download and install sizes of one build bundle per device model and OS version, as App Store Connect computed them after processing.

actions.name: list_build_bundles
actions.description: List the bundles (app, App Clip, and watch app) contained in one uploaded build, with their bundle identifiers, architectures, entitlements, and dSYM download URL. Every bundle of the build is returned in one call: App Store Connect only exposes bundles as an include of the build, capped at 50, and offers no cursor. Build bundle identifiers are needed for the App Clip and file size actions.

actions.name: list_build_individual_testers
actions.description: List the TestFlight testers who were assigned one build individually, outside of any group.

actions.name: list_builds
actions.description: List builds uploaded for one app, with the prerelease version each build belongs to. Filter by version, platform, processing state, or TestFlight review state.

actions.name: list_bundle_id_capabilities
actions.description: List the capabilities enabled on one bundle ID, with their configured settings.

actions.name: list_bundle_id_profiles
actions.description: List the provisioning profiles that were created for one bundle ID.

actions.name: list_bundle_ids
actions.description: List the bundle IDs (App IDs) registered with the team, optionally filtered by identifier, name, platform, or seed ID.

actions.name: list_certificates
actions.description: List the signing certificates of the team, including their base64 DER content, optionally filtered by type, display name, or serial number.

actions.name: list_ci_build_action_artifacts
actions.description: List the artifacts a build action produced, such as archives, log bundles, and result bundles, each with a time-limited download URL.

actions.name: list_ci_build_action_issues
actions.description: List the errors, warnings, analyzer warnings, and test failures a build action reported.

actions.name: list_ci_build_action_test_results
actions.description: List the per-test results of a test action, with the outcome on each destination.

actions.name: list_ci_build_run_actions
actions.description: List the actions (build, analyze, test, archive) of one build run with the progress and outcome of each.

actions.name: list_ci_build_run_builds
actions.description: List the App Store Connect builds an Xcode Cloud build run delivered, with the prerelease version each build belongs to. Use it to find the build to distribute after an archive action.

actions.name: list_ci_mac_os_version_xcode_versions
actions.description: List the Xcode versions that can run on one macOS version in Xcode Cloud.

actions.name: list_ci_mac_os_versions
actions.description: List the macOS versions Xcode Cloud can build on.

actions.name: list_ci_product_additional_repositories
actions.description: List the additional repositories of one Xcode Cloud product, such as Swift package dependencies Xcode Cloud has been granted access to.

actions.name: list_ci_product_build_runs
actions.description: List the build runs of one Xcode Cloud product across all of its workflows, optionally narrowed to the run that produced one build.

actions.name: list_ci_product_primary_repositories
actions.description: List the primary repositories of one Xcode Cloud product, the repositories that hold the project or package its workflows build.

actions.name: list_ci_product_workflows
actions.description: List the workflows of one Xcode Cloud product.

actions.name: list_ci_products
actions.description: List the Xcode Cloud products of the team, optionally narrowed to one app or to app or framework products. A product holds the workflows and build runs of one app or framework.

actions.name: list_ci_workflow_build_runs
actions.description: List the build runs of one Xcode Cloud workflow, optionally narrowed to the run that produced one build.

actions.name: list_ci_xcode_version_mac_os_versions
actions.description: List the macOS versions one Xcode version can run on in Xcode Cloud.

actions.name: list_ci_xcode_versions
actions.description: List the Xcode versions Xcode Cloud can build with, each with the simulators and Macs available for tests.

actions.name: list_customer_reviews
actions.description: List the App Store reviews of one app together with the developer response published for each review.

actions.name: list_devices
actions.description: List the devices registered with the team, optionally filtered by name, platform, UDID, or status.

actions.name: list_diagnostic_signatures
actions.description: List the diagnostic signatures App Store Connect collected for one build: recurring call patterns behind disk writes, hangs, or slow launches, weighted by how critical they are.

actions.name: list_game_center_achievement_version_localizations
actions.description: List the localizations of one Game Center achievement version, one per locale the achievement is shown in.

actions.name: list_game_center_achievement_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one Game Center achievement, each with the review and release state of the localizations it carries.

actions.name: list_game_center_activity_version_localizations
actions.description: List the locales one Game Center activity version has text for.

actions.name: list_game_center_activity_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one Game Center activity, each with its review and release state.

actions.name: list_game_center_app_version_compatibility_versions
actions.description: List the earlier app versions that stay multiplayer compatible with this one, so players who have not updated yet can still be matched with players who have. Optionally narrowed to the compatible versions that have Game Center enabled.

actions.name: list_game_center_challenge_version_localizations
actions.description: List the locales one Game Center challenge version carries text for.

actions.name: list_game_center_challenge_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one Game Center challenge, each with the review and release state it is in.

actions.name: list_game_center_detail_achievements
actions.description: List the achievements of one Game Center detail, optionally narrowed by reference name, archived state or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_detail_activities
actions.description: List the Game Center activities of one app, reached through its Game Center detail record. App Store Connect offers no filters here, so page through the results with limit and cursor.

actions.name: list_game_center_detail_app_versions
actions.description: List the App Store versions of the app together with their Game Center enablement, optionally narrowed to the enabled or the disabled ones.

actions.name: list_game_center_detail_challenges
actions.description: List the challenges configured on the Game Center detail of one app, optionally narrowed by reference name, archived state or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_detail_leaderboard_sets
actions.description: List the leaderboard sets of one Game Center detail, optionally narrowed by reference name or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_detail_leaderboards
actions.description: List the leaderboards of one Game Center detail, optionally narrowed by reference name, archived state or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_group_achievements
actions.description: List the achievements shared by one Game Center group, optionally narrowed by reference name, archived state or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_group_activities
actions.description: List the Game Center activities shared by the apps of one Game Center group. App Store Connect offers no filters here, so page through the results with limit and cursor.

actions.name: list_game_center_group_challenges
actions.description: List the challenges shared by the games of one Game Center group, optionally narrowed by reference name, archived state or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_group_details
actions.description: List the Game Center details of the apps that belong to one group, that is the apps sharing the achievements, leaderboards and leaderboard sets of the group.

actions.name: list_game_center_group_leaderboard_sets
actions.description: List the leaderboard sets shared by one Game Center group, optionally narrowed by reference name or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_group_leaderboards
actions.description: List the leaderboards shared by one Game Center group, optionally narrowed by reference name, archived state or identifier.

actions.name: list_game_center_groups
actions.description: List the Game Center groups of the team. Apps in a group share their achievements, leaderboards and leaderboard sets, so players keep one progress across the apps.

actions.name: list_game_center_leaderboard_set_leaderboards
actions.description: List the leaderboards that belong to one Game Center leaderboard set, optionally narrowed by reference name, by archived state, or to specific leaderboards.

actions.name: list_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localizations
actions.description: List the member localizations of one leaderboard inside one leaderboard set. A member localization is the name a leaderboard is shown under while a player browses the set, which can differ from the name of the leaderboard on its own. App Store Connect requires both the set and the leaderboard.

actions.name: list_game_center_leaderboard_set_version_localizations
actions.description: List the locales one Game Center leaderboard set version is translated into.

actions.name: list_game_center_leaderboard_set_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one Game Center leaderboard set. Each version carries its own localized names through App Review.

actions.name: list_game_center_leaderboard_version_localizations
actions.description: List the locales of one Game Center leaderboard version, each with the name, score description and score formatting shown to players.

actions.name: list_game_center_leaderboard_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one Game Center leaderboard. Each version carries its own localizations through App Review.

actions.name: list_game_center_matchmaking_queues
actions.description: List every Game Center matchmaking queue of the team, each with the rule set it matches requests with and the rule set of a running experiment.

actions.name: list_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set_queues
actions.description: List the matchmaking queues that match their requests with one rule set, either as their rule set or as their experiment rule set.

actions.name: list_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set_rules
actions.description: List the rules of one Game Center matchmaking rule set, with the expression each rule evaluates for a candidate match.

actions.name: list_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set_teams
actions.description: List the teams of one Game Center matchmaking rule set, with the player limits of each team.

actions.name: list_game_center_matchmaking_rule_sets
actions.description: List every Game Center matchmaking rule set of the team, with the player limits and the rule language version each one uses.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_available_territories
actions.description: List the territories an in-app purchase is currently sold in, using the availability record identifier from get_in_app_purchase_availability.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_localizations
actions.description: List the localized display names and descriptions of one in-app purchase, one record per locale.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_offer_code_custom_codes
actions.description: List the custom codes generated for an in-app purchase offer code.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_codes
actions.description: List the one-time-use code batches generated for an in-app purchase offer code. The code values are only available as a CSV download in App Store Connect.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_offer_code_prices
actions.description: List the discounted prices of an in-app purchase offer code per territory, with the price point, customer price, and proceeds of each.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_offer_codes
actions.description: List the offer code configurations of an in-app purchase, optionally narrowed to offers priced in one territory.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_price_point_equalizations
actions.description: List the price points in other territories that Apple considers equivalent to one price point, which is how automatic prices for a base territory are derived.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_price_points
actions.description: List the price points available to an in-app purchase, with the customer price and proceeds per territory. Use a price point identifier from here when building a price schedule or offer code price.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_price_schedule_automatic_prices
actions.description: List the prices App Store Connect derived automatically from the base territory of an in-app purchase price schedule.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_price_schedule_manual_prices
actions.description: List the manually set prices of an in-app purchase price schedule, with the price point, customer price, and proceeds of each.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_version_localizations
actions.description: List the localized display names and descriptions attached to one in-app purchase version.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchase_versions
actions.description: List the metadata versions of an in-app purchase, optionally narrowed to one review state.

actions.name: list_in_app_purchases
actions.description: List the in-app purchases of one app (consumables, non-consumables, and non-renewing subscriptions; auto-renewable subscriptions are a separate family). Filter by type, state, name, or product identifier.

actions.name: list_merchant_id_certificates
actions.description: List the Apple Pay certificates issued for one merchant ID, optionally filtered by type, display name, or serial number.

actions.name: list_merchant_ids
actions.description: List the Apple Pay merchant IDs registered with the team, optionally filtered by name or identifier.

actions.name: list_nominations
actions.description: List the featuring nominations of the team in the given states, optionally narrowed by type, related app, or whether they include in-app events.

actions.name: list_pass_type_id_certificates
actions.description: List the pass signing certificates issued for one pass type ID, optionally filtered by type, display name, or serial number.

actions.name: list_pass_type_ids
actions.description: List the Wallet pass type IDs registered with the team, optionally filtered by name or identifier.

actions.name: list_pre_release_versions
actions.description: List the prerelease versions of one app, which group its TestFlight builds by marketing version.

actions.name: list_profile_certificates
actions.description: List the certificates embedded in one provisioning profile.

actions.name: list_profile_devices
actions.description: List the devices a development or ad hoc provisioning profile allows.

actions.name: list_profiles
actions.description: List the provisioning profiles of the team, including their base64 content, optionally filtered by name, profile type, or validity state.

actions.name: list_promoted_purchases
actions.description: List the in-app purchases and subscriptions promoted on the App Store product page of one app, in display order.

actions.name: list_review_submission_items
actions.description: List the items in a review submission, each naming the App Store version, custom product page version, experiment, or in-app event it reviews.

actions.name: list_review_submissions
actions.description: List the review submissions of one app, with the App Store version each submission carries. Filter by platform or review state.

actions.name: list_sandbox_testers
actions.description: List the Sandbox Apple Accounts of the team used to test in-app purchases. Sandbox accounts are created and deleted in App Store Connect, not through the API.

actions.name: list_scm_provider_repositories
actions.description: List the repositories Xcode Cloud can access on one source control provider.

actions.name: list_scm_providers
actions.description: List the source control providers (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) connected to Xcode Cloud for the team.

actions.name: list_scm_repositories
actions.description: List every source repository Xcode Cloud can access across all connected providers, optionally narrowed to specific repository identifiers.

actions.name: list_scm_repository_git_references
actions.description: List the branches and tags of one repository as Xcode Cloud sees them. Their identifiers are what start_ci_build_run takes as sourceBranchOrTagId.

actions.name: list_scm_repository_pull_requests
actions.description: List the pull requests of one repository as Xcode Cloud sees them. Their identifiers are what start_ci_build_run takes as scmPullRequestId.

actions.name: list_subscription_group_localizations
actions.description: List the customer-facing localized names of one subscription group.

actions.name: list_subscription_group_version_localizations
actions.description: List the localized names attached to one subscription group version. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: list_subscription_group_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one subscription group, optionally narrowed by review state. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: list_subscription_groups
actions.description: List the subscription groups of one app, optionally narrowed by reference name or by the state of the subscriptions they contain.

actions.name: list_subscription_introductory_offers
actions.description: List the introductory offers of one auto-renewable subscription, with the territory and price point of each offer. Filter by territory to inspect one storefront.

actions.name: list_subscription_localizations
actions.description: List the customer-facing localized names and descriptions of one subscription.

actions.name: list_subscription_offer_code_custom_codes
actions.description: List the custom codes generated for one offer code configuration.

actions.name: list_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_codes
actions.description: List the one-time use code batches generated for one offer code configuration. The code values themselves are only available as a CSV download in App Store Connect.

actions.name: list_subscription_offer_code_prices
actions.description: List the territory prices of one offer code configuration, with the currency and customer price of each price point.

actions.name: list_subscription_offer_codes
actions.description: List the offer code configurations of one auto-renewable subscription, with the code counts and active state of each configuration.

actions.name: list_subscription_plan_availabilities
actions.description: List the territory availability records of one subscription, one per payment plan. Use list_subscription_plan_availability_territories for the full territory list of a record.

actions.name: list_subscription_plan_availability_territories
actions.description: List the territories in which one subscription plan availability sells the plan.

actions.name: list_subscription_price_point_adjusted_equalizations
actions.description: List the adjusted territory equalizations of one subscription price point, the equivalents App Store Connect proposes after its territory-specific price adjustments.

actions.name: list_subscription_price_point_equalizations
actions.description: List the price points in other territories that App Store Connect considers equivalent to one subscription price point, which is how a price set in one territory is carried over to the rest.

actions.name: list_subscription_price_points
actions.description: List the price points a subscription can be priced at, with the customer price and developer proceeds of each. Apple recommends filtering by territory and plans to make that filter mandatory.

actions.name: list_subscription_prices
actions.description: List the current and scheduled prices of one subscription, with the territory and price point of each price. Filter by territory, payment plan, or price point.

actions.name: list_subscription_promotional_offer_prices
actions.description: List the territory prices of one promotional offer, with the currency and customer price of each price point.

actions.name: list_subscription_promotional_offers
actions.description: List the promotional offers of one auto-renewable subscription. Use list_subscription_promotional_offer_prices to read the territory prices of an offer.

actions.name: list_subscription_version_localizations
actions.description: List the localized names and descriptions attached to one subscription version. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: list_subscription_versions
actions.description: List the versions of one subscription, optionally narrowed by review state. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: list_subscriptions
actions.description: List the auto-renewable subscriptions of one subscription group, optionally narrowed by name, product identifier, or state.

actions.name: list_territories
actions.description: List every App Store territory with its currency. Territory identifiers are used for license agreements, availability, and pricing.

actions.name: list_territory_availabilities
actions.description: List the per-territory availability of an app availability configuration: whether the app is on sale in each territory, its release date, pre-order settings and the content statuses that explain why it is or is not available.

actions.name: list_user_invitation_visible_apps
actions.description: List the apps a pending invitation will make visible to the invited user.

actions.name: list_user_invitations
actions.description: List pending invitations to join the App Store Connect team, optionally narrowed by email, role, or visible app.

actions.name: list_user_visible_apps
actions.description: List the apps a team member can see. For a user with allAppsVisible the list reflects every app on the team.

actions.name: list_users
actions.description: List the members of the App Store Connect team, with the roles granted to each of them.

actions.name: list_webhook_deliveries
actions.description: List the delivery attempts of one webhook, newest first as App Store Connect orders them, with the event each attempt carried and the response the endpoint returned. Filter by delivery state or creation time to find failed deliveries to resend.

actions.name: list_webhooks
actions.description: List the webhooks registered on one app, with the URL, enabled state, and subscribed event types of each.

actions.name: list_win_back_offer_prices
actions.description: List the territory prices of one win-back offer, with the currency and customer price of each price point.

actions.name: list_win_back_offers
actions.description: List the win-back offers of one auto-renewable subscription. Use list_win_back_offer_prices to read the territory prices of an offer.

actions.name: notify_build_testers
actions.description: Send the TestFlight availability notification for one build to every tester who can install it. The notification cannot be recalled, so use it only when automatic notifications were off.

actions.name: ping_webhook
actions.description: Send a test ping notification to a webhook so the endpoint and its signature check can be verified. The ping shows up in the webhook deliveries with ping set to true.

actions.name: redeliver_webhook_delivery
actions.description: Send the event of an earlier delivery again, for example after the endpoint was down. App Store Connect creates a new delivery marked as a redelivery; the original delivery record is kept.

actions.name: register_device
actions.description: Register a device with the team so development and ad hoc profiles can include it. Apple limits how many devices a team registers per membership year, and registered devices can only be removed in the Apple Developer website; use update_device to disable one instead.

actions.name: release_app_store_version
actions.description: Release an approved App Store version that is waiting in PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE to the App Store. The release starts immediately and cannot be undone.

actions.name: remove_achievements_from_game_center_activity
actions.description: Detach achievements from a Game Center activity. The achievements themselves are kept and stay available outside the activity.

actions.name: remove_beta_tester_from_apps
actions.description: Revoke a TestFlight tester's access to specific apps, removing them from every group and build of those apps while keeping them on the team.

actions.name: remove_beta_testers_from_group
actions.description: Remove testers from one TestFlight group. The testers stay on the team and keep access through their other groups.

actions.name: remove_build_from_beta_groups
actions.description: Withdraw one build from TestFlight groups so their testers can no longer install it.

actions.name: remove_builds_from_beta_group
actions.description: Withdraw several builds from one TestFlight group so its testers can no longer install them.

actions.name: remove_compatibility_versions_from_game_center_app_version
actions.description: Stop treating earlier Game Center app versions as multiplayer compatible with this one. Players still on a removed version can no longer be matched with players on this one.

actions.name: remove_individual_testers_from_build
actions.description: Remove the individual assignment of TestFlight testers from one build. Testers keep access through any group that has the build.

actions.name: remove_leaderboards_from_game_center_activity
actions.description: Detach leaderboards from a Game Center activity. The leaderboards themselves are kept together with the scores already posted to them.

actions.name: remove_leaderboards_from_game_center_leaderboard_set
actions.description: Take leaderboards out of a Game Center leaderboard set. The leaderboards themselves are kept and stay available on their own.

actions.name: remove_visible_apps_from_user
actions.description: Hide apps from a team member so they can no longer open them in App Store Connect.

actions.name: reorder_promoted_purchases
actions.description: Set the display order of the promoted purchases of an app. The list replaces the current order, so include every promoted purchase that should stay listed.

actions.name: replace_game_center_detail_achievements
actions.description: Replace the achievements attached to a Game Center detail. The identifiers you pass become the complete set, so an achievement left out is detached from the app.

actions.name: replace_game_center_detail_challenges_minimum_platform_versions
actions.description: Replace the earliest App Store versions, one per platform, that may take part in Game Center challenges. The identifiers you pass become the complete set, so a platform left out no longer has a minimum version.

actions.name: replace_game_center_detail_leaderboard_sets
actions.description: Replace the leaderboard sets attached to a Game Center detail. The identifiers you pass become the complete set, so a leaderboard set left out is detached from the app.

actions.name: replace_game_center_detail_leaderboards
actions.description: Replace the leaderboards attached to a Game Center detail. The identifiers you pass become the complete set, so a leaderboard left out is detached from the app.

actions.name: replace_game_center_group_achievements
actions.description: Set which achievements one Game Center group shares. Pass the complete list: an achievement left out is no longer shared through the group.

actions.name: replace_game_center_group_leaderboard_sets
actions.description: Set which leaderboard sets one Game Center group shares. Pass the complete list: a leaderboard set left out is no longer shared through the group.

actions.name: replace_game_center_group_leaderboards
actions.description: Set which leaderboards one Game Center group shares. Pass the complete list: a leaderboard left out is no longer shared through the group.

actions.name: replace_game_center_leaderboard_set_leaderboards
actions.description: Replace the whole list of leaderboards in a Game Center leaderboard set. Leaderboards missing from the new list leave the set but are not deleted.

actions.name: replace_user_visible_apps
actions.description: Replace the whole set of apps a team member can see. Apps missing from the new list are hidden from the user.

actions.name: resend_beta_tester_invitation
actions.description: Send the TestFlight invitation email again to a tester who has not accepted the invitation for one app.

actions.name: respond_to_customer_review
actions.description: Publish a developer response to an App Store review. App Store Connect treats this as an upsert: an existing response for the same review is replaced, and publication is asynchronous.

actions.name: revoke_certificate
actions.description: Revoke a certificate that was lost, stolen, compromised, or is expiring. Revocation is permanent and cannot be undone: apps signed with the certificate can no longer be re-signed with it, every provisioning profile that contains it becomes invalid, and Developer ID or Apple Pay certificates may need Apple to restore service. Issue a replacement with create_certificate first when the certificate is still in use.

actions.name: set_app_clip_default_experience_release_version
actions.description: Attach a default App Clip experience to the App Store version it is released with, replacing any version attached before.

actions.name: set_app_store_version_build
actions.description: Select the build an App Store version submits for review, replacing any build selected before. Pass null as buildId to detach the current build.

actions.name: set_game_center_achievement_activity
actions.description: Attach a Game Center achievement to a game activity, replacing the activity it was attached to before.

actions.name: set_game_center_challenge_leaderboard
actions.description: Score a Game Center challenge on another leaderboard, replacing the leaderboard it used before. App Store Connect does not accept detaching the leaderboard, so a leaderboard identifier is always required.

actions.name: set_game_center_leaderboard_activity
actions.description: Link a Game Center leaderboard to the game activity it belongs to, replacing any activity linked before. App Store Connect confirms the change without returning the leaderboard.

actions.name: set_game_center_leaderboard_challenge
actions.description: Link a Game Center leaderboard to the challenge that ranks players against it, replacing any challenge linked before. App Store Connect confirms the change without returning the leaderboard.

actions.name: start_ci_build_run
actions.description: Start an Xcode Cloud build run for a workflow. Pass the Git reference of the branch or tag to build, or the pull request to build; the run is queued and progresses asynchronously, so read it back with get_ci_build_run.

actions.name: submit_build_for_beta_review
actions.description: Submit a build for TestFlight beta review, which external groups require before they can install it.

actions.name: submit_game_center_leaderboard_entry
actions.description: Post a score to a Game Center leaderboard on behalf of a player. This is how a server-authoritative game reports scores its own backend computed instead of letting the game client submit them.

actions.name: submit_game_center_player_achievement
actions.description: Report a player's progress towards a Game Center achievement from a server instead of from the game client. Submitting 100 marks the achievement earned.

actions.name: submit_in_app_purchase_for_review
actions.description: Submit an in-app purchase to App Review. The purchase must be in READY_TO_SUBMIT; once submitted it cannot be edited until review finishes.

actions.name: submit_review_submission
actions.description: Send a prepared review submission and all of its items to App Review. The submission moves to WAITING_FOR_REVIEW and can only be taken back with cancel_review_submission.

actions.name: test_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set
actions.description: Run a Game Center matchmaking rule set against a set of simulated requests and return the matches it would have formed, with the team each simulated player was assigned to. Nothing is stored and no real player is matched, so this is safe to run against a rule set that is already attached to a queue.

actions.name: update_accessibility_declaration
actions.description: Change the supported accessibility features of a declaration, or publish it by passing publish: true, which replaces the currently published declaration for that device family. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_age_rating_declaration
actions.description: Answer or change questions of the age rating questionnaire. Only the given answers are overwritten; App Store Connect recalculates the derived age ratings. Pass at least one answer.

actions.name: update_android_to_ios_app_mapping_detail
actions.description: Change the package name or replace the full list of signing certificate fingerprints of an Android app mapping. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app
actions.description: Update app-level settings such as the primary locale, third-party content rights declaration, server notification URLs, or accessibility URL. Overwrites the given attributes; pass null for a URL to clear it. Pass at least one attribute.

actions.name: update_app_clip_advanced_experience
actions.description: Change the action, business category, default language, place, header image, or localized card text of an advanced App Clip experience. Overwrites the given fields; a given localizations list is written inline and replaces the relationship. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app_clip_app_store_review_detail
actions.description: Replace the invocation URLs App Review uses to test a default App Clip experience. Pass an empty list to remove them all.

actions.name: update_app_clip_default_experience
actions.description: Change the action of a default App Clip experience or the App Store version it is released with. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app_clip_default_experience_localization
actions.description: Change the subtitle of a default App Clip experience localization, or pass null to remove it.

actions.name: update_app_custom_product_page
actions.description: Rename a custom product page or toggle its visibility on the App Store. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one.

actions.name: update_app_custom_product_page_localization
actions.description: Replace the promotional text of a custom product page localization, or clear it with null.

actions.name: update_app_custom_product_page_version
actions.description: Set or clear the deep link of a custom product page version. Overwrites the existing deep link; pass null to remove it.

actions.name: update_app_event
actions.description: Change the reference name, badge, deep link, purchase requirement, locale, priority, purpose, or territory schedules of an in-app event. Overwrites the given fields; pass null for deepLink or purchaseRequirement to clear it. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app_event_localization
actions.description: Change the name or descriptions of an in-app event localization. Overwrites the given fields; pass null to clear a field. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app_info
actions.description: Set the App Store categories of an app info record. Each given category replaces the current one; subcategories only apply when the matching category is Games or Stickers. Pass at least one category. Use list_app_categories to find identifiers.

actions.name: update_app_info_localization
actions.description: Change the name, subtitle, or privacy URLs of an app info localization. Overwrites the given fields; pass null to clear a subtitle, URL, or privacy text. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app_store_review_detail
actions.description: Overwrite the App Review contact details, demo account, or notes of an App Store version. Only the given fields change; pass null to clear a text field.

actions.name: update_app_store_version
actions.description: Change the version string, copyright, review or release settings, or attached build of an App Store version. Each given field overwrites the current value; pass null for copyright or earliestReleaseDate to clear them.

actions.name: update_app_store_version_experiment
actions.description: Rename a product page optimization test, change its traffic proportion, or start it by passing started true. Starting a test is not reversible: it begins serving treatments to App Store traffic and can only be stopped, not returned to draft. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app_store_version_experiment_treatment
actions.description: Rename a treatment or change its alternate app icon. Overwrites the given fields; pass null as appIconName to return to the default icon. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_app_store_version_localization
actions.description: Overwrite the localized App Store metadata of one version in one locale. Only the given fields change; pass null to clear a field.

actions.name: update_app_store_version_phased_release
actions.description: Pause, resume, or complete the phased rollout of a released version. COMPLETE releases the version to every user at once and cannot be undone.

actions.name: update_background_asset
actions.description: Archive or unarchive a background asset pack. Archiving is the only change App Store Connect accepts on an asset pack; the identifier and versions stay as they are.

actions.name: update_beta_app_clip_invocation
actions.description: Change the invocation URL of a TestFlight App Clip invocation. The previous URL is overwritten.

actions.name: update_beta_app_clip_invocation_localization
actions.description: Change the title of one localized App Clip invocation title. The locale itself cannot be changed; the previous title is overwritten.

actions.name: update_beta_app_localization
actions.description: Change the TestFlight test information of one app localization. Each field given replaces the stored value; pass at least one.

actions.name: update_beta_app_review_detail
actions.description: Change the contact person, demo account, or notes Apple uses when reviewing an app for TestFlight. Each field given replaces the stored value; pass at least one. The identifier comes from get_beta_app_review_detail.

actions.name: update_beta_build_localization
actions.description: Replace the "What to Test" notes of one existing build localization. The previous text is overwritten.

actions.name: update_beta_group
actions.description: Change the name, public link, feedback, or Apple silicon and Apple Vision availability settings of one TestFlight group. Each field given replaces the stored value; pass at least one.

actions.name: update_beta_license_agreement
actions.description: Replace the license agreement text TestFlight testers of an app must accept. The identifier comes from get_beta_license_agreement.

actions.name: update_beta_recruitment_criterion
actions.description: Replace the device family and OS version filters of existing recruitment criteria. The previous filters are overwritten.

actions.name: update_build
actions.description: Change the TestFlight flags of one build: expire it so testers can no longer install it, or record whether it uses non-exempt encryption. Expiring a build cannot be undone. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_build_beta_detail
actions.description: Turn automatic tester notifications on or off for one build. The build beta detail identifier comes from get_build_beta_detail.

actions.name: update_build_test_notes
actions.description: Set the "What to Test" notes a build shows testers in one locale. Updates the existing notes for that locale, or creates them when the locale has none yet.

actions.name: update_bundle_id
actions.description: Rename a bundle ID. The name is the only attribute App Store Connect lets you change; the identifier string and platform are fixed once registered.

actions.name: update_bundle_id_capability
actions.description: Replace the configuration of a capability that is already enabled on a bundle ID, for example the iCloud version or data protection level. Provide at least one of capabilityType or settings; the settings given replace the current ones.

actions.name: update_certificate
actions.description: Activate or deactivate a certificate. App Store Connect only exposes the activation state, which applies to Apple Pay payment processing certificates; a deactivated certificate stops being used for payment processing until it is activated again.

actions.name: update_ci_workflow
actions.description: Change an Xcode Cloud workflow. Every field given replaces the current value; a start condition or the actions array is replaced as a whole, so pass the complete new object. Give at least one field to change.

actions.name: update_device
actions.description: Rename a registered device or change its status. Provide at least one of name or status. Disabling a device invalidates the development and ad hoc profiles that include it, while the device keeps counting toward the yearly device limit; re-enabling it keeps the same record.

actions.name: update_end_user_license_agreement
actions.description: Replace the text of a custom end user license agreement or the full set of territories it applies in. Pass at least one of agreementText or territoryIds.

actions.name: update_game_center_achievement
actions.description: Change the configuration of a Game Center achievement, or archive it so it is no longer offered to players. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The vendor identifier cannot be changed after the achievement was created.

actions.name: update_game_center_achievement_localization
actions.description: Change the name or the descriptions of a Game Center achievement localization, or clear one of them with null. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The locale cannot be changed; delete the localization and create it again instead.

actions.name: update_game_center_activity
actions.description: Change the configuration of a Game Center activity or archive it. Overwrites the given fields and passing null clears one; vendorIdentifier cannot change once the activity exists. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_game_center_activity_localization
actions.description: Replace the name or the description of a Game Center activity localization, or clear one with null. The locale cannot change; delete the localization and create it again instead. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_game_center_activity_version
actions.description: Set or clear the fallback URL of a Game Center activity version. Overwrites the existing URL; pass null to remove it.

actions.name: update_game_center_app_version
actions.description: Enable or disable Game Center for the App Store version this record belongs to. Disabling it hides Game Center from players on that release without deleting its achievements or leaderboards.

actions.name: update_game_center_challenge
actions.description: Rename a Game Center challenge, archive it, change whether players may repeat it, or score it on another leaderboard. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The vendor identifier and the challenge type cannot be changed after creation.

actions.name: update_game_center_challenge_localization
actions.description: Replace the name or the description of a Game Center challenge localization, or clear one of them with null. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The locale cannot be changed, so replace the localization to move the text to another locale.

actions.name: update_game_center_detail
actions.description: Move a Game Center detail into a group, or change the leaderboards shown by default in the Game Center dashboard. Overwrites the relationships you pass; pass at least one. App Store Connect does not echo the linked identifiers on this call, so read them back with get_game_center_detail.

actions.name: update_game_center_group
actions.description: Rename a Game Center group. Overwrites the reference name; pass null to clear it. The apps and the shared records of the group are not touched.

actions.name: update_game_center_leaderboard
actions.description: Change the configuration of a Game Center leaderboard or archive it. Overwrites the given fields and clears the ones passed as null; pass at least one. The vendorIdentifier cannot be changed. Archiving retires the leaderboard so it stops accepting scores.

actions.name: update_game_center_leaderboard_localization
actions.description: Change the text or score formatting of a Game Center leaderboard localization. Overwrites the given fields and clears the ones passed as null; pass at least one. The locale cannot be changed.

actions.name: update_game_center_leaderboard_set
actions.description: Rename a Game Center leaderboard set, or clear its reference name with null. The vendor identifier is fixed once the set exists and cannot be changed.

actions.name: update_game_center_leaderboard_set_localization
actions.description: Replace the set name of a Game Center leaderboard set localization, or clear it with null. The locale is fixed once the localization exists; delete and recreate it to change the locale.

actions.name: update_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localization
actions.description: Replace the name a leaderboard is shown under inside a leaderboard set, or clear it with null so the leaderboard falls back to its usual localized name.

actions.name: update_game_center_matchmaking_queue
actions.description: Point a Game Center matchmaking queue at another rule set, change the rule set its experiment runs with, or replace the classic matchmaking bundle identifiers. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The queue name cannot be changed after creation.

actions.name: update_game_center_matchmaking_rule
actions.description: Change the expression, the description or the weight of a Game Center matchmaking rule, or clear one of them with null. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The rule name and its type cannot be changed.

actions.name: update_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set
actions.description: Change the player limits of a Game Center matchmaking rule set, or clear a limit with null. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The rule set name and its rule language version cannot be changed.

actions.name: update_game_center_matchmaking_team
actions.description: Change the player limits of a Game Center matchmaking team, or clear a limit with null. Overwrites the given fields; pass at least one. The team name cannot be changed, because rule expressions refer to it.

actions.name: update_in_app_purchase
actions.description: Update the reference name, review note, or Family Sharing flag of an in-app purchase. Pass at least one field; each given field overwrites the current value.

actions.name: update_in_app_purchase_localization
actions.description: Overwrite the display name or description of an in-app purchase localization. Pass at least one field; the locale itself cannot be changed.

actions.name: update_in_app_purchase_offer_code
actions.description: Activate or deactivate an in-app purchase offer code. Deactivating stops every custom and one-time-use code of the offer from being redeemed.

actions.name: update_in_app_purchase_offer_code_custom_code
actions.description: Activate or deactivate one custom code of an in-app purchase offer without touching the other codes of the offer.

actions.name: update_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_code
actions.description: Activate or deactivate one batch of one-time-use codes of an in-app purchase offer.

actions.name: update_in_app_purchase_version_localization
actions.description: Overwrite the display name or description of an in-app purchase version localization. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_marketplace_search_detail
actions.description: Replace the sitemap catalog URL of an existing marketplace search detail.

actions.name: update_merchant_id
actions.description: Rename an Apple Pay merchant ID. The name is the only attribute App Store Connect lets you change.

actions.name: update_nomination
actions.description: Change a featuring nomination, submit a draft with submitted true, or archive it with archived true. Overwrites the given fields; a given list of apps, events, or territories replaces the current one. Pass null for publishEndDate or notes to clear it. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_pass_type_id
actions.description: Rename a Wallet pass type ID. The name is the only attribute App Store Connect lets you change.

actions.name: update_promoted_purchase
actions.description: Change whether a promoted purchase is enabled or visible to all customers. Pass at least one field.

actions.name: update_review_submission_item
actions.description: Mark a review submission item as resolved after fixing the issues App Review raised, or mark it as removed so the submission continues without it.

actions.name: update_sandbox_tester
actions.description: Change the territory, interrupted-purchase setting, or subscription renewal rate of a sandbox tester. Changes can take up to an hour to reach the sandbox environment. Pass at least one field to change.

actions.name: update_subscription
actions.description: Change the reference name, subscription period, Family Sharing setting, review note, or group level of a subscription. Pass at least one field; each given field overwrites the existing value. Family Sharing cannot be turned off again once enabled for an approved subscription.

actions.name: update_subscription_grace_period
actions.description: Change the billing grace period settings of an app: turn it on or off in production or the sandbox, set its length, or choose which renewals it covers. Pass at least one field; the change applies to every subscription of the app.

actions.name: update_subscription_group
actions.description: Rename a subscription group. The new reference name replaces the existing one.

actions.name: update_subscription_group_localization
actions.description: Change the customer-facing name or custom app name of a subscription group in one locale. Pass at least one field; the locale itself cannot be changed.

actions.name: update_subscription_group_version_localization
actions.description: Change the customer-facing name or custom app name of a subscription group version localization. Pass at least one field; the locale itself cannot be changed. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: update_subscription_introductory_offer
actions.description: Change the end date of an introductory offer, or remove the end date so the offer runs until it is deleted. Apple allows no other change; create a new offer to change the price, duration, or mode.

actions.name: update_subscription_localization
actions.description: Change the customer-facing name or description of a subscription in one locale. Pass at least one field; the locale itself cannot be changed.

actions.name: update_subscription_offer_code
actions.description: Activate or deactivate an offer code configuration. Deactivating it stops every custom and one-time use code of the configuration from being redeemed; Apple allows no other change after creation.

actions.name: update_subscription_offer_code_custom_code
actions.description: Activate or deactivate a custom code. A deactivated code can no longer be redeemed until it is activated again.

actions.name: update_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code
actions.description: Activate or deactivate a one-time use code batch. Deactivating it stops every unredeemed code in the batch from being redeemed.

actions.name: update_subscription_plan_availability
actions.description: Change the territories a subscription payment plan is sold in, or whether it opens automatically in new territories. Pass at least one field; availableTerritoryIds replaces the whole territory list, so territories left out stop selling the plan.

actions.name: update_subscription_promotional_offer
actions.description: Set territory prices on an existing promotional offer. Each submitted territory replaces the price already stored for it; other attributes of the offer cannot be changed after creation.

actions.name: update_subscription_version_localization
actions.description: Change the customer-facing name or description of a subscription version localization. Pass at least one field; the locale itself cannot be changed. Versions belong to the App Store Connect API 4.4 review flow: a version is a draft of the localized metadata that goes through App Review, and the live record is replaced once the version is approved.

actions.name: update_territory_availability
actions.description: Change the availability of an app in one territory: toggle whether it is available, set or clear its release date, or enable pre-orders. Pass at least one field; the others keep their current values.

actions.name: update_user
actions.description: Change the roles, app visibility, or provisioning access of a team member. Roles and visible apps replace the current values rather than adding to them. Pass at least one field to change.

actions.name: update_webhook
actions.description: Change the name, URL, secret, event types, or enabled state of a webhook. Each given field replaces the current value; eventTypes replaces the whole list.

actions.name: update_win_back_offer
actions.description: Change the schedule, priority, promotion intent, or customer eligibility of a win-back offer. Only the given fields change; the identifier, duration, mode, period count, and prices cannot be changed after creation.

provider.description: Manage App Store in-app purchase transactions, subscriptions, refunds, server notifications, and retention messaging.

fields.label: Issuer ID
fields.description: The issuer ID shown above the In-App Purchase key list in App Store Connect.

fields.label: Key ID
fields.description: The identifier shown next to the In-App Purchase key in App Store Connect.

fields.label: Private Key (.p8)
fields.description: The complete SubscriptionKey_<KEYID>.p8 contents. Use an In-App Purchase key, not an App Store Connect API key. Escaped \n line breaks are accepted.

fields.label: Bundle ID
fields.description: The bundle identifier of the app this connection acts on.

fields.label: Environment
fields.description: The App Store server environment: production or sandbox.

actions.name: configure_default_retention_message
actions.description: Set the default retention message the App Store shows for one subscription product in one locale, replacing any default configured before. Only text-based messages, with or without an image, can be defaults, and both the message and its image must be APPROVED. Products without a default in a locale show no retention message there, and the default is also the fallback when your real-time endpoint fails. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: configure_retention_realtime_url
actions.description: Register the URL of your Get Retention Message endpoint for the environment of this connection, replacing any URL registered before. Once set, the App Store calls it whenever a subscriber opens the cancellation flow and shows the message you pick. A production URL is accepted only after your endpoint passed the sandbox performance test (Apple answers 403 otherwise). Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: delete_default_retention_message
actions.description: Remove the default retention message of one subscription product in one locale, so the App Store shows no retention message there. Succeeds even when no default was configured. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: delete_retention_image
actions.description: Delete an uploaded retention image. Apple refuses with 403 while a message still references the image, so delete the message first; a missing image answers 404. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: delete_retention_message
actions.description: Delete an uploaded retention message. A missing message answers 404. Stop returning the identifier from your Get Retention Message endpoint first, and delete any image it used afterwards with delete_retention_image. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: delete_retention_realtime_url
actions.description: Unregister the Get Retention Message endpoint URL for the environment of this connection. Afterwards the App Store shows only default messages in that environment until a URL is registered again. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: extend_renewal_date_for_all_active_subscribers
actions.description: Extend the renewal date of every active subscription to one product, optionally limited to some storefronts. The App Store processes the request asynchronously; poll get_subscription_renewal_date_extension_status for the outcome. The extension cannot be reversed.

actions.name: extend_subscription_renewal_date
actions.description: Extend the renewal date of one customer's active auto-renewable subscription, to compensate for a service outage or a cancelled event. The extension cannot be reversed, and Apple emails the customer about the new renewal date.

actions.name: finish_transaction
actions.description: Tell the App Store that your server finished delivering the content for a transaction. Call it only after the customer has the content; it cannot be undone. Apple still returns a finished transaction from get_transaction_history, so do not treat its disappearance as confirmation.

actions.name: get_all_subscription_statuses
actions.description: Read the status of every auto-renewable subscription a customer has for your app, grouped by subscription group, with the latest transaction and renewal information of each decoded from the signed payloads Apple returns.

actions.name: get_app_transaction_info
actions.description: Read the app download transaction for a customer, decoded from the signed payload Apple returns. It records when and on which platform the customer first acquired the app.

actions.name: get_default_retention_message
actions.description: Read which message is configured as the default retention message for one subscription product in one locale. Returns a null messageIdentifier when no default is configured there. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: get_notification_history
actions.description: List the App Store Server Notifications the App Store tried to deliver to your server in a time span, with each notification payload decoded. History covers the past 180 days in production and the past 30 days in sandbox, and returns up to 20 records per page.

actions.name: get_refund_history
actions.description: List the in-app purchase transactions the App Store refunded for a customer in your app, newest first, decoded from the signed payloads Apple returns. Returns up to 20 transactions per page.

actions.name: get_retention_image_list
actions.description: List every image uploaded for retention messaging in this app and environment, with its size slot and approval state. Only images and messages in the APPROVED state are shown to customers; the sandbox approves uploads immediately. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: get_retention_message_list
actions.description: List every message uploaded for retention messaging in this app and environment, with its approval state. A message that carries an image also needs that image to be APPROVED; check it with get_retention_image_list. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: get_retention_performance_test_results
actions.description: Read the outcome of a sandbox performance test started with initiate_retention_performance_test: PENDING while it runs, then PASS or FAIL together with the measured response times, success rate and failure counts. Available only on a connection whose environment is sandbox; Apple serves the performance test endpoints on the sandbox host alone. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: get_retention_realtime_url
actions.description: Read the URL of the Get Retention Message endpoint registered for the environment of this connection. Returns a null realtimeUrl when none is registered. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: get_subscription_renewal_date_extension_status
actions.description: Check how far the App Store has got with a renewal date extension that was requested for all active subscribers of a product.

actions.name: get_test_notification_status
actions.description: Read the delivery result of a test notification, with the notification payload decoded from the signed payload Apple returns. Apple answers 404 until it has finished the first delivery attempt.

actions.name: get_transaction_history
actions.description: List a customer's in-app purchase transactions for your app, oldest first by default, decoded from the signed payloads Apple returns. Pass sort DESCENDING to get the most recent transactions first. Returns up to 20 transactions per page.

actions.name: get_transaction_info
actions.description: Read one in-app purchase transaction by identifier, decoded from the signed payload Apple returns.

actions.name: initiate_retention_performance_test
actions.description: Start Apple's performance test of the Get Retention Message endpoint registered in the sandbox, using an active sandbox subscription as the sample purchase. Passing the test is required before configure_retention_realtime_url accepts a production URL. Returns the request identifier and the test parameters; the test runs for the returned totalDuration. Available only on a connection whose environment is sandbox; Apple serves the performance test endpoints on the sandbox host alone. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: look_up_order_id
actions.description: Look up the in-app purchase transactions behind an order ID from a customer's App Store receipt, to check that the order is genuine and belongs to your app. Apple serves this endpoint only in the production environment, so it fails on a sandbox connection.

actions.name: request_test_notification
actions.description: Ask the App Store to send a TEST notification to the App Store Server Notifications URL configured for your app, and get back the token that identifies the attempt. Fails when no notification URL is configured for the selected environment.

actions.name: send_consumption_information
actions.description: Send consumption information for an in-app purchase after a CONSUMPTION_REQUEST notification, so the App Store can decide on the customer's refund request. Apple expects an answer within 12 hours of the notification. Use this for App Store in-app purchases that do not go through the Advanced Commerce API.

actions.name: send_consumption_information_v1
actions.description: Send the version 1 consumption information for an in-app purchase after a CONSUMPTION_REQUEST notification. Apple documents this shape for purchases made through the Advanced Commerce API; use send_consumption_information for ordinary App Store in-app purchases.

actions.name: set_app_account_token
actions.description: Set or replace the app account token on a transaction, to associate a purchase made outside your app with a customer on your own service. Overwrites any token already set.

actions.name: upload_retention_image
actions.description: Upload a PNG image for retention messages, either a FULL_SIZE image shown above the message body or a BULLET_POINT icon. The image starts in the PENDING state and Apple reviews it before it can be displayed; check the state with get_retention_image_list. Each app can hold up to 2000 images and an identifier can be uploaded only once. Only images and messages in the APPROVED state are shown to customers; the sandbox approves uploads immediately. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

actions.name: upload_retention_message
actions.description: Upload the text of a retention message: a header, a body, optionally a full-size image and bullet points with icons. The message starts in the PENDING state and Apple reviews it; check the state with get_retention_message_list. Leave out image and bulletPoints for messages you will use as switch-plan or promotional-offer messages. Each app can hold up to 2000 messages and an identifier can be uploaded only once. Only images and messages in the APPROVED state are shown to customers; the sandbox approves uploads immediately. Apple grants Retention Messaging API access per developer account; without it these endpoints answer 404 with no error body.

auth.label: API Key Secret
auth.description: Appcircle organization API key secret. Create one under My Organization > Security > API Keys: https://docs.appcircle.io/account/my-organization/security/api-keys.

extraFields.label: API Key Name
extraFields.description: The name assigned to the Appcircle organization API key.

extraFields.label: Organization ID
extraFields.description: Optional Appcircle organization ID used to scope the access token.

actions.name: list_build_profiles
actions.description: List Appcircle Build profiles for the connected organization.

actions.name: list_distribution_profiles
actions.description: List Appcircle Testing Distribution profiles for the connected organization.

actions.name: list_enterprise_store_profiles
actions.description: List Appcircle Enterprise App Store profiles for the connected organization.

actions.name: list_organizations
actions.description: List Appcircle organizations available to the connected API key.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Appcues Public API key. Create it at https://studio.appcues.com/settings/keys

extraFields.label: Region
extraFields.description: Use us or eu.

actions.name: get_flow
actions.description: Get one Appcues Flow 2.0 experience by identifier.

actions.name: get_tag
actions.description: Get one Appcues content tag by identifier.

actions.name: list_flows
actions.description: List Appcues Flow 2.0 experiences for the connected account.

actions.name: list_tags
actions.description: List content tags for the connected Appcues account.

actions.name: publish_flow
actions.description: Publish one Appcues Flow 2.0 experience.

actions.name: unpublish_flow
actions.description: Unpublish one Appcues Flow 2.0 experience.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: AppDrag project API key forwarded as the APIKey request parameter. Open the official AppDrag dashboard, then use the "API" or "Databases" dashboard to copy or regenerate the shared project API key described here: https://support.appdrag.com/doc/Authentication-and-Access-Control.

actions.name: execute_function
actions.description: Execute one AppDrag Cloud Backend API function by folder, function name, HTTP method, and optional parameters.

provider.description: Manage Apple Ads accounts, campaigns, targeting, creatives, reports, insights, and change history through the Apple Ads Platform API.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The clientId shown after saving a public key under Apple Ads Account Settings > API. https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apple-ads-platform-api/implementing-oauth-for-the-apple-ads-platform-api

fields.label: Team ID
fields.description: The teamId shown under Apple Ads Account Settings > API. https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apple-ads-platform-api/implementing-oauth-for-the-apple-ads-platform-api

fields.label: Key ID
fields.description: The keyId assigned to the public key uploaded under Apple Ads Account Settings > API. https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apple-ads-platform-api/implementing-oauth-for-the-apple-ads-platform-api

fields.label: Private Key (PEM)
fields.description: The EC P-256 private key paired with the public key uploaded to Apple Ads. SEC1 and PKCS#8 PEM are accepted, including escaped \n line breaks.

fields.label: Ad Account ID
fields.description: Optional default ad account sent as X-AP-Context. Leave empty to pass adAccountId to each scoped action.

actions.name: apply_daily_budget_recommendations
actions.description: Accept one or more daily budget recommendations. Apple Ads raises each campaign's daily budget and moves the recommendation to the terminal APPLIED state.

actions.name: apply_target_cpa_recommendations
