actions.name: create_a_collection
actions.description: Tool to create a new Postman collection in a specific workspace or the default workspace. Use when you need to create a collection with workspace specification. For complete collection format details, refer to the Postman Collection Format documentation.

actions.name: create_a_collection_comment
actions.description: Tool to create a comment on an API's collection. Use when you need to add a comment to a specific collection within an API. To create a reply on an existing comment, include the thread_id in the request.

actions.name: create_a_collection_from_a_schema
actions.description: Tool to create a collection from a schema and link it to an API with specified relations. Note: This endpoint is deprecated in Postman v10 and higher. Use when you need to generate a collection from an API schema and establish relations like contract tests or documentation.

actions.name: create_a_folder
actions.description: Tool to create a folder in a Postman collection. Use when you need to organize requests by creating a new folder within a collection. For complete details, see the Postman Collection Format documentation.

actions.name: create_a_folder_comment
actions.description: Tool to create a comment on a folder. Use when you need to add a comment to a specific folder in a collection.

actions.name: create_a_fork2
actions.description: Tool to create a fork from an existing environment into a workspace. Use when you need to fork an environment to a specified workspace.

actions.name: create_a_mock_server
actions.description: Tool to create a new mock server in a Postman collection. Use when you need to create a mock server to simulate API endpoints for testing or development. Returns the created mock server's details including the mockUrl which can be used to make requests.

actions.name: create_a_monitor
actions.description: Tool to create a new monitor in a specific workspace to run a collection on a schedule. Use when you need to set up automated collection runs at specified intervals using cron expressions within a workspace.

actions.name: create_a_pull_request
actions.description: Tool to create a pull request for a forked collection into its parent collection. Use when you need to propose changes from a forked collection to be merged into the parent collection. The forked collection must exist before creating a pull request.

actions.name: create_a_request
actions.description: Tool to create a new request in a Postman collection. Use when you need to add a request to an existing collection with specified method, URL, headers, and body.

actions.name: create_a_request_comment
actions.description: Tool to create a comment on a request. Use when you need to add a comment to a specific request within a collection or reply to an existing comment thread.

actions.name: create_a_response
actions.description: Tool to create a request response in a Postman collection. Use when you need to add a saved response example to a specific request in a collection.

actions.name: create_a_response_comment
actions.description: Tool to create a comment on a response. Use when you need to add a comment to a specific response within a collection or reply to an existing comment thread.

actions.name: create_a_schema
actions.description: Tool to create a schema for an API in Postman. Use when you need to add a schema definition (such as OpenAPI, GraphQL, or Protocol Buffers) to an existing API. The schema can consist of single or multiple files. Returns the created schema's ID and metadata upon successful creation.

actions.name: create_a_server_response
actions.description: Tool to create a server response on a Postman mock server. Use when you need to simulate 5xx server-level responses (500, 503, etc.) for testing error conditions.

actions.name: create_a_spec
actions.description: Tool to create an API specification in Postman's Spec Hub. Use when you need to create single or multi-file specifications in a workspace. Supports various spec types including OpenAPI 3.0, OpenAPI 3.1, and AsyncAPI 2.0.

actions.name: create_a_spec_file
actions.description: Tool to create a new file in an API specification. Use when you need to add a new file (such as schema definitions, path configurations, or components) to an existing spec.

actions.name: create_a_webhook
actions.description: Tool to create a webhook that triggers a collection with a custom payload. Use when you need to set up a webhook endpoint that can trigger a Postman collection run. The webhook URL is available in the webhookUrl property of the response.

actions.name: create_a_workspace
actions.description: Tool to create a new workspace in Postman. Use when you need to create a workspace with a specified name, type (personal, team, private, or public), and optional description. Returns the created workspace's ID, name, and type upon successful creation.

actions.name: create_an_api
actions.description: Tool to create a new API in Postman. Use when you need to create an API with a name, summary, and description in your Postman workspace.

actions.name: create_an_environment
actions.description: Tool to create a new environment in a Postman workspace. Use when you need to create a new environment with variables for different settings (development, production, testing, etc.). Returns the created environment's ID, name, and UID upon successful creation.

actions.name: create_or_update_a_schema_file
actions.description: Tool to create or update an API schema file in Postman. Use when you need to add a new schema file or modify an existing one within an API schema. Requires API ID, schema ID, file path, and stringified JSON content.

actions.name: create_relations
actions.description: Tool to create new relations for an API version. Use when you need to link collections or mock servers to an API version as contract tests, test suites, documentation, or mocks.

actions.name: delete_a_collection
actions.description: Tool to permanently delete a collection from Postman. Use when you need to remove a collection that is no longer needed.

actions.name: delete_a_collections_comment
actions.description: Tool to delete a comment from an API's collection. Use when you need to remove a specific comment from a collection. On success, returns HTTP 204 No Content.

actions.name: delete_a_folder
actions.description: Tool to delete a folder in a Postman collection. Use when you need to remove a folder and all its contents from a collection. The folder ID should not contain spaces to avoid 404 errors.

actions.name: delete_a_folders_comment
actions.description: Tool to delete a comment from a folder. Use when you need to remove a specific comment from a folder. Returns HTTP 204 No Content on successful deletion.

actions.name: delete_a_requests_comment
actions.description: Tool to delete a comment from a request. Use when you need to remove a specific comment from a request. On success, this returns an HTTP 204 No Content response.

actions.name: delete_a_response
actions.description: Tool to delete a response in a Postman collection. Use when you need to remove a saved response from a collection.

actions.name: delete_a_responses_comment
actions.description: Tool to delete a comment from a response. Use when you need to remove a specific comment from a collection response. On successful deletion, this returns HTTP 204 No Content.

actions.name: delete_a_schema_file
actions.description: Tool to delete a file in an API schema. Use when you need to remove a specific file from a schema. On success, returns HTTP 204 No Content response.

actions.name: delete_a_server_response
actions.description: Tool to delete a mock server's server response. Use when you need to remove a specific response from a Postman mock server.

actions.name: delete_a_spec
actions.description: Tool to delete an API specification from Postman. Use when you need to permanently remove a specification. On success, returns HTTP 204 No Content response.

actions.name: delete_a_spec_file
actions.description: Tool to delete a file from an API specification. Use when you need to remove a specific file from a multi-file specification.

actions.name: delete_a_workspace
actions.description: Tool to delete a Postman workspace permanently. Use when you need to remove a workspace and all its contents. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

actions.name: delete_an_api
actions.description: Tool to delete an API from Postman. Use when you need to permanently remove an API. On success, returns HTTP 204 No Content response.

actions.name: delete_an_apis_comment
actions.description: Tool to delete a comment from an API. Use when you need to remove a comment from a specific API. On success, this returns an HTTP 204 No Content response indicating the comment was successfully deleted.

actions.name: delete_an_environment
actions.description: Tool to delete an environment permanently in Postman. Use when you need to remove an environment that is no longer needed.

actions.name: delete_monitor
actions.description: Tool to delete a monitor by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a monitor from Postman. The monitor ID must be provided to identify which monitor to delete.

actions.name: duplicate_a_collection
actions.description: Tool to create a duplicate of a collection in another workspace. Use when you need to copy an existing collection to a different workspace. Returns an asynchronous task that can be tracked using the duplication task status endpoint.

actions.name: fork_collection
actions.description: Tool to create a fork of a collection in a specified workspace. Use when you need to fork an existing collection to a workspace.

actions.name: generate_a_collection_from_spec
actions.description: Tool to generate a Postman collection from an OpenAPI 2.0, 3.0, or 3.1 specification. Use when you need to create a collection from an existing API spec. The operation is asynchronous and returns a task ID and polling URL to check the generation status.

actions.name: generate_spec_from_collection
actions.description: Tool to generate an API specification from a Postman collection. Use when you need to create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification from an existing collection. The operation is asynchronous and returns a task ID and polling URL to check the generation status.

actions.name: get_a_collections_comments
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all comments left by users in an API's collection. Use when you need to fetch all comments associated with a specific collection within an API.

actions.name: get_a_collections_forks
actions.description: Tool to get all forks of a specific collection. Use when you need to retrieve information about who has forked a collection, including fork IDs, users, and creation dates.

actions.name: get_a_collections_pull_requests
actions.description: Tool to get information about a collection's pull requests including source and destination IDs, status, and URLs. Use when you need to retrieve pull request details for a specific collection.

actions.name: get_a_collections_roles
actions.description: Tool to get information about all roles in a collection. Use when you need to retrieve the IDs of all users, teams, and groups with access to view or edit a collection.

actions.name: get_a_folder
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about a folder in a Postman collection. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific folder including its name, description, owner, and timestamps.

actions.name: get_a_folders_comments
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all comments left by users in a folder. Use when you need to fetch all comments associated with a specific folder within a collection.

actions.name: get_a_monitor
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific monitor in Postman. Use when you need to fetch monitor details including schedule, collection, environment, and run status.

actions.name: get_a_request
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific request in a Postman collection. Use when you need to fetch details about a request including its method, URL, headers, body, authentication, and associated scripts.

actions.name: get_a_requests_comments
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all comments left by users in a request. Use when you need to fetch all comments associated with a specific request within a collection.

actions.name: get_a_response
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about a saved response in a Postman collection. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific response including status, headers, body, and metadata.

actions.name: get_a_responses_comments
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all comments left by users in a response. Use when you need to fetch all comments associated with a specific response within a collection.

actions.name: get_a_schema
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about an API schema from Postman. Use when you need to fetch schema details for a specific API. Optionally specify a version ID to get a schema published in a specific API version.

actions.name: get_a_spec
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about an API specification in Postman. Use when you need to fetch spec details including name, type, and timestamps.

actions.name: get_a_spec_file
actions.description: Tool to get the contents of an API specification's file. Use when you need to retrieve the actual content and metadata of a specific file within a spec.

actions.name: get_a_specs_definition
actions.description: Tool to get the complete contents of an API specification's definition. Use when you need to retrieve the full OpenAPI/Swagger specification content for a spec. Returns the raw definition content as a string.

actions.name: get_a_specs_files
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all files in an API specification from Postman. Use when you need to list or view specification files for a specific spec ID. Returns file metadata including IDs, names, paths, types, and timestamps.

actions.name: get_a_specs_generated_collections
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all collections generated from an API specification in Postman. Use when you need to fetch collections that have been auto-generated from a spec. Returns metadata and an array of generated collections.

actions.name: get_a_team_user
actions.description: Tool to get information about a user on the Postman team. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific team member including their ID, name, email, roles, and join date.

actions.name: get_a_workspace
actions.description: Tool to get detailed information about a specific workspace by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve the complete structure of a workspace including all collections, environments, APIs, mocks, and monitors.

actions.name: get_a_workspaces_activity_feed
actions.description: Tool to get a workspace's activity feed showing who added or removed collections, environments, or elements, and users joining or leaving. Use when you need to track workspace changes and user activity.

actions.name: get_a_workspaces_roles
actions.description: Tool to get the roles of users, user groups, and partners in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve role assignments and understand who has what level of access to a specific workspace.

actions.name: get_accounts
actions.description: Tool to retrieve Postman billing account details for the authenticated team. Use when you need to access account information such as account ID, team ID, account state, billing slots, sales channel, or billing email.

actions.name: get_all_api_releases
actions.description: Tool to get all releases for a specific API version in Postman. Use when you need to list releases for an API version. Note: This endpoint is deprecated in Postman v10 and higher.

actions.name: get_all_apis
actions.description: Tool to get all APIs accessible to the authenticated user with optional workspace filtering. Use when you need to list or retrieve APIs from Postman. Returns an array of API objects with their IDs, names, summaries, and other metadata.

actions.name: get_all_collections2
actions.description: Tool to get all collections accessible to the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve all your collections including subscribed collections. Returns detailed information for each collection including owner, creation/update timestamps, and visibility.

actions.name: get_all_environments
actions.description: Tool to get all environments accessible to the authenticated user with optional workspace filtering. Use when you need to list or retrieve environments from Postman. Returns an array of environment objects with their IDs, names, and UIDs.

actions.name: get_all_forked_collections
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all forked collections for the authenticated user. Use when you need to list or access all collections that the user has forked.

actions.name: get_all_groups
actions.description: Tool to get all user groups in a Postman team. Use when you need to list all groups and their details including member counts and timestamps. Returns an array of group objects with their IDs, names, team IDs, user counts, and creation/update timestamps.

actions.name: get_all_linked_relations
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all linked relations for a specific API version in Postman. Use when you need to discover what collections, documentation, mocks, or monitors are linked to an API version.

actions.name: get_all_mock_servers
actions.description: Tool to get all active mock servers accessible to the authenticated user. Use when you need to list or retrieve mock servers from Postman. By default, returns only mock servers you created across all workspaces. Can be filtered by workspace ID to get mock servers specific to a workspace.

actions.name: get_all_monitors
actions.description: Tool to get all monitors accessible to the authenticated user with optional workspace filtering. Use when you need to list or retrieve monitors from Postman. Returns an array of monitor objects with their IDs, names, and UIDs.

actions.name: get_all_specs
actions.description: Tool to get all API specifications in a workspace. Use when you need to list or retrieve API specs from a specific Postman workspace. Returns an array of spec objects with their IDs, names, types, and timestamps, along with pagination metadata.

actions.name: get_all_team_users
actions.description: Tool to get information about all users on the Postman team. Use when you need to list all team members and their details including roles and join dates. Returns an array of user objects with their IDs, names, usernames, emails, roles, and join timestamps.

actions.name: get_all_test_relations
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all test relations for a specific API version. Use when you need to get test relations associated with an API version. Note: This endpoint is deprecated in Postman v10 and higher.

actions.name: get_all_versions
actions.description: Tool to get all published versions of a specific API in Postman. Use when you need to list or retrieve version information for an API. Returns an array of version objects with their IDs and names.

actions.name: get_all_workspaces
actions.description: Tool to get all workspaces accessible to the authenticated user with optional type filtering. Use when you need to list or retrieve workspaces from Postman. Returns an array of workspace objects with their IDs, names, and types.

actions.name: get_an_api
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific API in Postman. Use when you need to fetch API details including name, description, versions, and schemas.

actions.name: get_an_api_version
actions.description: Tool to get information about a specific API version in Postman. Use when you need to retrieve details about a particular version of an API. Returns version details including ID, name, creation date, and associated schemas.

actions.name: get_an_apis_comments
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all comments left by users in an API. Use when you need to fetch all comments associated with a specific API.

actions.name: get_an_environment
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific environment in Postman. Use when you need to fetch environment details including name, ID, owner, and all environment variables.

actions.name: get_an_environments_forks
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all forked environments for a specific environment. Use when you need to list all environments that have been forked from a particular environment.

actions.name: get_async_collection_update_status
actions.description: Tool to get the status of an asynchronous collection update task. Use when you need to check whether a previously initiated async collection update is still processing, has completed successfully, or has failed. The task ID is obtained from PUT /collections/{collectionId} endpoint when using the Prefer: respond-async header.

actions.name: get_authenticated_user
actions.description: Tool to get information about the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve details about the current authenticated user, including their user ID, username, and email address.

actions.name: get_collection_access_keys
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all personal and team collection access keys for the authenticated user. Use when you need to list or manage collection access keys. Returns an array of access key objects with their IDs, tokens, status, and associated collection information.

actions.name: get_contract_test_relations
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contract test relations for a specific API version. Use when you need to check contract test associations. Note: This endpoint is deprecated and may return limited or no data.

actions.name: get_documentation_relations
actions.description: Tool to get documentation relations for a specific API version. This endpoint is deprecated in Postman v10 and higher.

actions.name: get_duplication_task_status
actions.description: Tool to get the status of a collection duplication task. Use when you need to check whether a previously initiated collection duplication is still processing or has completed. The task ID must first be obtained from the POST /collections/{collectionId}/duplicates endpoint.

actions.name: get_environment_relations
actions.description: Tool to get environment relations for a specific API version. This endpoint is deprecated in Postman v10 and higher.

actions.name: get_generated_spec
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the API specification generated for a Postman collection. Use when you need to fetch OpenAPI/Swagger specs that have been auto-generated from a collection. Returns metadata and an array of generated specifications.

actions.name: get_global_variables
actions.description: Tool to get a workspace's global variables. Use when you need to retrieve global variables that are available throughout a workspace for access between collections, requests, scripts, and environments. Note that this endpoint only works with personal or team workspaces, not public workspaces.

actions.name: get_integration_test_relations
actions.description: Tool to get integration test relations for a specific API version. This endpoint is deprecated and may not return active data.

actions.name: get_resource_types
actions.description: Tool to get all resource types supported by Postman's SCIM API. Use when you need to discover what resource types (e.g., User, Group) are available in the SCIM API and their corresponding endpoints and schemas.

actions.name: get_schema_file_contents
actions.description: Tool to get the contents of an API schema file at a specified path. Use when you need to retrieve the actual content of a schema file. Optionally specify a version ID to get file contents from a specific API version.

actions.name: get_schema_files
actions.description: Tool to retrieve files in an API schema from Postman. Use when you need to list or view schema files for a specific API and schema ID. Optionally filter by version ID to get files from a particular API version.

actions.name: get_service_provider_configuration
actions.description: Tool to get Postman's SCIM API service provider configuration information. Use when you need to discover supported SCIM operations, capabilities, and authentication schemes. This endpoint returns configuration details including support for PATCH, bulk operations, filtering, sorting, and ETag handling.

actions.name: get_source_collections_status
actions.description: Tool to check whether there is a change between a forked collection and its parent (source) collection. Use when you need to determine if the source collection has updates that are not yet in the forked collection. This endpoint only works with forked collections; attempting to use it with regular collections will result in an error.

actions.name: get_test_suite_relations
actions.description: Tool to get test suite relations for a specific API version. Use when you need to retrieve the test suites associated with an API version. Note: This endpoint is deprecated and only works with legacy v9 APIs. For v10+ APIs, this returns an empty array.

actions.name: get_unclassified_relations
actions.description: Tool to get unclassified relations for an API version in Postman. Use when you need to retrieve unclassified relations for a specific API version. This endpoint is for Postman v10 and higher.

actions.name: import_openapi
actions.description: Tool to import an OpenAPI specification into Postman as a new collection. Use when you need to convert an OpenAPI 3.0+ specification into a Postman collection within a specific workspace. The imported specification will be automatically converted to a Postman collection with all endpoints, request parameters, and documentation.

actions.name: list_account_invoices
actions.description: Tool to get all invoices for a Postman billing account filtered by status. Use when you need to retrieve invoice history for an account. The account ID must first be obtained from the GET /accounts endpoint.

actions.name: merge_a_fork
actions.description: Tool to merge a forked collection back into its parent collection. This endpoint is deprecated. Use when you need to merge changes from a forked collection into the parent collection.

actions.name: merge_a_fork2
actions.description: Tool to merge a forked environment back into its parent environment. Use when you need to merge changes from a forked environment into the parent.

actions.name: publish_a_mock_server
actions.description: Tool to publish a mock server in Postman. Use when you need to make a mock server publicly accessible. Publishing sets the mock server's Access Control configuration to public.

actions.name: pull_source_changes2
actions.description: Tool to pull changes from a parent (source) collection into a forked collection. Use when you need to sync a forked collection with its parent.

actions.name: replace_an_environments_data
actions.description: Tool to completely replace an environment's data with new variables and values. Use when you need to update an entire environment by replacing all its contents. This operation replaces ALL existing variables with the ones provided in the request.

actions.name: replace_collections_data_asynchronously
actions.description: Tool to replace the entire contents of a collection asynchronously. Use when you need to completely replace a collection with new data. IMPORTANT: Include the collection's ID values in item, variable, and other nested objects to preserve them. If you do not include IDs, existing items will be removed and new items will be created.

actions.name: resolve_a_comment_thread
actions.description: Tool to resolve a comment thread and any associated replies. Use when you need to mark a comment thread as resolved. On success, this returns an HTTP 204 No Content response.

actions.name: review_a_pull_request
actions.description: Tool to update the review status of a pull request by approving, declining, or unapproving it. Use when you need to perform a review action on a Postman pull request.

actions.name: run_a_monitor
actions.description: Tool to trigger an immediate run of a monitor and retrieve its execution results. Use when you need to manually execute a monitor outside of its scheduled runs.

actions.name: sync_collection_with_schema
actions.description: Tool to sync a collection attached to an API with the API schema. This is an asynchronous endpoint that returns HTTP 202 Accepted. Use when you need to synchronize a collection with changes made to the API schema. The collection must already be attached to the API. Returns a task ID that can be used to check the status of the sync operation.

actions.name: sync_collection_with_spec
actions.description: Tool to sync a collection generated from an API specification. This is an asynchronous operation that returns HTTP 202 Accepted. Use when you need to update a collection to match the latest version of its source API specification. The collection must have been generated from a spec.

actions.name: sync_spec_with_collection
actions.description: Tool to sync an API specification with a linked collection. This is an asynchronous operation that returns HTTP 202 Accepted with task tracking information. Use when you need to synchronize changes from a generated collection back to its source specification. Prerequisites: the collection must be generated from the spec, and the spec must be single-file.

actions.name: transfer_folders
actions.description: Tool to copy or move folders into a collection or folder. Use when you need to reorganize collections by transferring folders between collections or into other folders.

actions.name: transform_collection_to_openapi
actions.description: Tool to transform an existing Postman Collection into a stringified OpenAPI 3.0.3 definition. Use when you need to convert a collection to OpenAPI format for API documentation or interoperability with other tools.

actions.name: update_a_folder
actions.description: Tool to update a folder in a Postman collection. Use when you need to modify the name or description of an existing folder. For complete properties and information, see the Postman Collection Format documentation.

actions.name: freight_bid_report_operation_node
actions.description: Report an operation node for a bidding install order (供应商自主报价操作节点回传). operate_data's required keys depend on operate_code: OP000006 needs installMaster+installConcat, OP000004 needs appTime, OP000008/OP000001/OP000010 need imgUrl, OP000013 needs closeReason.

actions.name: freight_bid_report_refund_result
actions.description: Report the master's decision on a bidding install order's refund request (退款结果回传).

actions.name: freight_bid_send_evidence_notice
actions.description: Ask the customer for supplementary evidence while handling a complaint (通知用户补充举证). The deadline defaults to 12 hours after the notice time.

actions.name: freight_bid_submit_master_evidence
actions.description: Submit the master's evidence for a complaint on a bidding install order (师傅举证回传).

actions.name: freight_bid_submit_quote
actions.description: Submit a supplier master's quote for a bidding install order (回传报价).

actions.name: freight_cancel_install_order
actions.description: Cancel an appended install service; the waybill must not be picked up yet.

actions.name: freight_cancel_ltl_order
actions.description: Cancel an SF Freight LTL order. Only orders not yet picked up can be cancelled.

actions.name: freight_cancel_recovery_order
actions.description: Cancel an SF recovery order; not possible once the master has arrived.

actions.name: freight_cancel_tl_order
actions.description: Cancel an SF Freight truckload order. Cancellation only succeeds while the order is in a cancellable state; otherwise the error message explains why.

actions.name: freight_check_address_reachable
actions.description: Check whether an address is within SF Freight pickup or delivery coverage (订单筛单).

actions.name: freight_city_calc_fee
actions.description: Calculate the freight fee for an SF Freight city-delivery shipment before ordering.

actions.name: freight_city_cancel_order
actions.description: Cancel an SF Freight city-delivery order.

actions.name: freight_city_confirm_order
actions.description: Place an SF Freight city-delivery (城市配送货运) order. send_start_time must be at least 2 hours in the future.

actions.name: freight_city_get_order_detail
actions.description: Get the details of an SF Freight city-delivery order by order number or client order number.

actions.name: freight_city_list_appointment_times
actions.description: Get the pickup appointment time window available for a city in SF Freight city delivery.

actions.name: freight_city_list_available_vas
actions.description: List the value-added services available for a city and vehicle model in SF Freight city delivery.

actions.name: freight_city_list_cities
actions.description: List the cities where SF Freight city delivery is available.

actions.name: freight_city_list_orders
actions.description: List SF Freight city-delivery orders for an ordering phone number, with optional time and pagination filters.

actions.name: freight_city_list_vehicles
actions.description: List the vehicle models available for a city and business scenario in SF Freight city delivery.

actions.name: freight_create_install_order
actions.description: Create an SF install order (安装单下单): install-only, pickup-and-install, or repair.

actions.name: freight_create_ltl_order
actions.description: Place an SF Freight (快运) LTL order for bulky or heavy shipments. This is for 大件 special scenarios only; for regular parcels use sf_express.create_order. When waybill_no is provided, the order uses that reserved master waybill number instead of generating one.

actions.name: freight_create_recovery_order
actions.description: Create an SF recovery order (回收单下单) for door-to-door goods recycling. The pickup date must be within 3 days, the window whole hours between 08:00 and 21:00.

actions.name: freight_create_tl_order
actions.description: Create an SF Freight truckload (整车直达) order. Set generate_waybill_no to have SF assign a waybill number, or pass your own waybill_no. A monthly card (monthly_card) is required when pay_method is 1 (寄付月结) or 2 (寄付转第三方).

actions.name: freight_create_vehicle_track_url
actions.description: Create the vehicle track playback page URL for an SF Freight waybill. Requires the monthly card that paid the waybill.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_cancel_order
actions.description: Cancel one or more SF cross-border bulky orders by waybill number.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_confirm_delivery_window
actions.description: Confirm and update a new delivery window option for an FBA shipment as the carrier agent.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_get_delivery_window
actions.description: Query the current delivery window of an FBA shipment as the carrier agent.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_get_pod_info
actions.description: Query the proof-of-delivery information for an SF cross-border bulky waybill.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_get_print_batch
actions.description: Start an SF cross-border bulky waybill print download and get the print batch number.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_place_order
actions.description: Place an SF cross-border bulky (大件跨境) order and receive the master and sub waybill numbers. A monthly card (monthly_card) is required when settlement_type is 2 (寄付月结).

actions.name: freight_crossborder_query_delivery_window_options
actions.description: Query the selectable delivery window options for an FBA shipment as the carrier agent.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_query_postcode_address
actions.description: Check whether a destination postal code is served for SF cross-border bulky shipments, returning the address info and remote-area flag.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_query_print_result
actions.description: Get the waybill print file download URLs for a print batch created by freight_crossborder_get_print_batch.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_report_trace
actions.description: Report logistics traces for an SF cross-border bulky shipment, as the carrier agent. Routes are stored newest first; milestone values make the corresponding nodes visible to end customers.

actions.name: freight_crossborder_upload_pod_files
actions.description: Upload proof-of-delivery files for an SF cross-border bulky waybill, as publicly accessible file URLs.

actions.name: freight_forward_apply_add_fee
actions.description: Apply for an additional last-mile fee on an SF Freight forwarding waybill; currently only 入仓垫付 (warehouse entry advance, type 50) is supported.

actions.name: freight_forward_apply_monthly_payment
actions.description: Bind the payment of an SF Freight forwarding waybill to a monthly settlement card (月结卡号) so the fee is charged to it. Requires a monthly card.

actions.name: freight_forward_place_return_order
actions.description: Place a return-receipt order (标快到付) for one or more SF Freight forwarding waybills.

actions.name: freight_forward_report_exception
actions.description: Report an exception for an SF Freight forwarding waybill, for example damage, miscount, delay, or a reweigh appeal. delay_days is required for codes SIGN_03/SIGN_05/SIGN_15/TRANSITING_15; weight and sub_items are required for the reweigh codes HANDOVER_06/TRANSITING_17.

actions.name: freight_forward_start_pay
actions.description: Get the payment QR code for an unpaid SF Freight forwarding waybill.

actions.name: freight_forward_update_order_status
actions.description: Upload a real-time order status update for an SF Freight forwarding shipment.

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_driver
actions.description: Upload the pickup driver information for an SF Freight forwarding order once the carrier assigns the driver.

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_receipt
actions.description: Upload the sign-back receipt number for an SF Freight forwarding waybill.

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_return_route
actions.description: Upload route events for an SF Freight forwarding return receipt. Upload incrementally, newest first; cover all loading, unloading, out-for-delivery, and signed nodes.

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_route
actions.description: Upload route events for an SF Freight forwarding waybill. Upload incrementally, newest first; cover all loading, unloading, and out-for-delivery nodes (use freight_forward_upload_sign_image for the signed node).

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_sign_image
actions.description: Upload the recipient's signature or other proof-of-delivery images for an SF Freight forwarding waybill; SF reviews them and then marks the waybill signed. Image URLs must be publicly accessible.

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_track
actions.description: Upload one vehicle track point for an SF Freight forwarding waybill.

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_track_batch
actions.description: Upload multiple vehicle track points for one SF Freight forwarding waybill in a single call. All track points must belong to the same waybill number.

actions.name: freight_forward_upload_waybill_remark
actions.description: Upload a remark for an SF Freight forwarding waybill.

actions.name: freight_get_ltl_order_result
actions.description: Get the latest dispatch result of an SF Freight LTL order placed with courier call (下call), including the assigned waybill numbers.

actions.name: freight_list_crossborder_transfer_nos
actions.description: List the transfer waybill numbers (转单号) of an SF cross-border bulky mother waybill.

actions.name: freight_notify_install_arrival
actions.description: Mark an install order's goods as arrived (到货通知), optionally completing the pickup address. Only the not-arrived to arrived transition is supported.

actions.name: freight_query_crossborder_route
actions.description: Query the route of an SF cross-border bulky (大件跨境) waybill. For transfer waybill numbers (转单号), use freight_query_crossborder_transfer_routes.

actions.name: freight_query_crossborder_transfer_routes
actions.description: Query the route events of a transfer waybill number (转单号) for an SF cross-border bulky shipment.

actions.name: freight_query_delivery_rules
actions.description: Query the home-delivery service rules (宅配规则) bound to one or more SF monthly cards.

actions.name: freight_query_install_order
actions.description: Query an SF install order's status and fee breakdown by client order number.

actions.name: freight_query_recovery_products
actions.description: Query the full SF recovery product catalog (回收品类). The list is large and returned in full; cache it instead of calling repeatedly.

actions.name: freight_query_standard_price
actions.description: Query the standard base freight price for an SF Freight product between two addresses. At least one of weight, size, or declare_value is required for pricing.

actions.name: freight_query_tl_order
actions.description: Query an SF Freight truckload order by client order number; pass waybill_no as well when you have it.

actions.name: freight_register_ltl_picture_push
actions.description: Register an SF Freight waybill for waybill picture push. The picture push callback must be configured in the SF console before pushes arrive.

actions.name: freight_reply_work_order
actions.description: Reply to an SF Freight work order, identified by work_order_id or report_source_no (at least one).

actions.name: freight_report_work_order
actions.description: Report a work order (工单) about an SF Freight shipment to SF customer service.

actions.name: freight_supplier_apply_add_fee
actions.description: Apply for an add-fee on a bidding install order as the supplier (供应商侧发起增加费用).

actions.name: freight_supplier_query_add_fee_result
actions.description: Query the result of a supplier add-fee application (增加费用结果查询); the fallback when the result push or report fails.

actions.name: freight_supplier_query_appointment_times
actions.description: Query the appointment times a supplier's master may offer for an install task (送装协同可预约时间).

actions.name: freight_supplier_report_operation_node
actions.description: Report an install-task operation node to SF as the supplier (操作节点回传): assign master, pickup, appointment, arrival check, completion, review, fault detection, and more. Required fields depend on operate_code; images are required for codes 3, 17, 20, 21.

actions.name: freight_update_install_order
actions.description: Update an install order's customer info, non-SF logistics info, or cargo images. Customer and logistics info can only change before a master is assigned; cargo images can change until the waybill is signed.

actions.name: get_sub_waybill_nos
actions.description: Allocate additional child waybill numbers (子单号) for an existing SF Express order, at most 20 per call.

actions.name: intercept_order
actions.description: Intercept, redirect, return, or adjust an in-transit SF Express waybill (截单转寄退回), for example redirecting it to a new address or returning it to the sender. Only for waybills already picked up; cancel an unshipped order with update_order instead.

actions.name: list_print_templates
actions.description: List a merchant's published custom print templates with their placeholder fields (ISV 自定义模板列表).

actions.name: pre_order
actions.description: Validate whether an SF Express order would be accepted (预下单) — checks cargo, monthly card, address reachability, and number controls — without creating it, and returns the available service time windows.

actions.name: print_waybill_cainiao_template
actions.description: Convert waybills into Cainiao print template URLs (云打印面单转菜鸟模板) for systems already integrated with the Cainiao print component.

actions.name: print_waybill_command
actions.description: Convert waybills into printer command sets (云打印面单转指令, cpcl or zpl), returned inline as text or as downloadable files.

actions.name: print_waybill_html
actions.description: Generate waybill HTML print files from a cloud print template (云打印面单转HTML). Returns download URLs that need the returned token in the X-Auth-token header (valid 24h).

actions.name: print_waybill_pdf
actions.description: Generate waybill PDF print files from a cloud print template (云打印面单转PDF). Returns download URLs that need the returned token in the X-Auth-token header (valid 24h).

actions.name: query_citywide_print_status
actions.description: Query the status and generated PDF files of a 大同城 citywide print batch.

actions.name: query_delivery_time_price
actions.description: Query the SF Express delivery time standards for an origin and destination, optionally with freight prices per product.

actions.name: query_order_result
actions.description: Query the processing result of a previously placed SF Express order, for example when the create_order response never arrived.

actions.name: query_service_points
actions.description: List nearby SF Express service points (自营服务点, 合作商家店, 顺丰站, 丰巢柜, and more) around an address or a coordinate.

actions.name: query_waybill_fee
actions.description: Query the freight fee breakdown (清单运费) of an SF Express shipment by order number (only orders placed under your partnerID) or by waybill number (the waybill's monthly card must be bound to your partnerID).

actions.name: recommend_product
actions.description: Recommend SF Express products with prices and promised delivery times for a shipment.

actions.name: recommend_vas
actions.description: Recommend value-added services (保鲜, 保价, 定时派送, and more) with prices for a shipment on a chosen product.

actions.name: register_route_push
actions.description: Register an SF Express order or waybill for route (tracking) push. Prerequisite: the route push callback must already be configured in the SF console (控制台 → 开发者对接 → 查看API → 路由注册接口 → 配置信息); after registration, SF pushes route updates to that address.

actions.name: register_waybill_picture_push
actions.description: Register a waybill for waybill picture push (回单 receipt, 清单 manifest, 拍照回传 photo proof, etc.). SF pushes the AES-encrypted picture to the configured callback once generated; register after the shipment is signed for, because pictures are produced late. The decryption key comes from the SF console (控制台 → 开发者对接 → 查看API → 图片注册及推送接口).

actions.name: save_print_template
actions.description: Save a merchant custom print template (ISV 保存自定义模板); same name means a new version of the same template. The content follows the SF markup language spec.

actions.name: search_routes
actions.description: Query logistics routes (tracking events) for up to 10 SF Express shipments. Waybill-only queries return routes only for shipments paid with a monthly card bound to your partnerID; for any other shipment, pass the sender or recipient phone's last 4 digits in check_phone_nos. Only shipments from the last 3 months have routes.

actions.name: send_delivery_notice
actions.description: Send a delivery or return notification for an SF Express waybill (派件通知), used in pre-sale scenarios where the goods were stocked in an SF warehouse in advance.

actions.name: station_add_brand_inspection_images
actions.description: Submit brand-inspection images for a station task (品牌巡检相册新增); resubmitting the same task_id updates its images.

actions.name: station_add_store_images
actions.description: Attach business-license, filing, or album image file names to an external station (外部驿站上传营业执照、末端备案、相册).

actions.name: station_batch_inventory
actions.description: Batch-upload the 600 route (滞留件盘点) for waybills held at a partner station.

actions.name: station_check_delivery_operation
actions.description: Check whether an operator on a channel may handle a waybill at a store (渠道可派件交接管控).

actions.name: station_check_waybill
actions.description: Check whether a waybill is valid for external-station operations (外部驿站运单校验); an SF waybill without a recipient phone cannot receive station SMS.

actions.name: station_courier_pickup_in_store
actions.description: Register that an SF courier picked up the consigned parcels from a store (顺丰小哥到店收件).

actions.name: station_customer_pickup_in_store
actions.description: Register that a customer picked up their parcel at a store (顾客到店取件). When receiver_payment is 1 (到付), weight, pack_fee, insurance_money, insurance_fee and successfully_payed_fee are required.

actions.name: station_customer_receive_pack
actions.description: Check out a waybill at an external station when the customer picks it up (外部驿站派件出库, route 658).

actions.name: station_customer_send_in_store
actions.description: Register a customer drop-off at a store (顾客到店寄件). When receiver_payment is 0 (寄付), weight, pack_fee, insurance_money and insurance_fee are required.

actions.name: station_get_oss_token
actions.description: Get an OSS token for direct image upload (获取OSSToken信息). The oss_client_name and path_id values come from your SF Express contact.

actions.name: station_handle_exception_return
actions.description: Report an exception return for a waybill at an external station (驿站异常件退件处理).

actions.name: station_handover_pack
actions.description: Check in a delivery waybill at an external station (外部驿站派件入库, route 657).

actions.name: station_notify_recipient
actions.description: Send a pickup notification SMS to the recipient of a waybill held at a station.

actions.name: station_pre_handover_pack
actions.description: Pre-check-in a delivery waybill at an external station (外部驿站派件预入库) before the physical handover.

actions.name: station_query_centralization
actions.description: Query whether a waybill is a centralized (集收/集派) shipment through the station general query API.

actions.name: station_query_grid_schedule
actions.description: Query the grid/bin assignment for a courier's shift at a station (星管家排班信息查询).

actions.name: station_query_store_info
actions.description: Query a station's information. One of virtual_addr or store_code is required. The returned field names vary by api_version.

actions.name: station_query_waybill_info
actions.description: Query a waybill's contact, payer and fee details (通用运单查询). Phone and address fields in the response are encrypted by SF Express.

actions.name: station_query_waybill_route
actions.description: Query the route events of a waybill for the station channel.

actions.name: station_save_store
actions.description: Create or update an external station (新增/修改外部驿站). Omit virtual_addr to create; pass it to update an existing station.

actions.name: station_save_village_store
actions.description: Create or update a township agent station (乡镇代理基本信息新增).

actions.name: station_save_xgj_store
actions.description: Create or update a 星管家 station's base information (星管家基本信息新增).

actions.name: station_send_sms
actions.description: Send a pickup-code SMS for a waybill from an external station (外部驿站发送短信).

actions.name: station_send_waybill_sms
actions.description: Send a fixed-template notification SMS for a waybill to its recipient or sender.

actions.name: station_store_batch_inventory
actions.description: Batch-upload the 600 route (滞留件盘点) for waybills held at a convenience store.

actions.name: station_store_handle_exception_return
actions.description: Report an exception return for a waybill at a store (门店异常件退件处理).

actions.name: station_store_receive_delivery
actions.description: Register that a store received parcels handed over by an SF courier (门店接收小哥派件).

actions.name: station_submit_fc_resource
actions.description: Submit or update a Hive Box service station's information (丰巢服务站信息接收或更新).

actions.name: station_submit_receipt_info
actions.description: Submit a waybill's receipt information with its fee, service, mark and addition lists (回单信息).

actions.name: station_temp_store
actions.description: Report a temporary station hold for a waybill (驿站暂存): bill_type 1 = 收端暂存 (route 410), 2 = 派端暂存 (route 210).

actions.name: station_update_outsource_info
actions.description: Submit or update the regional outsourcing information (区域外包信息变更) for outsourced station areas.

actions.name: station_update_xgj_insurance_fee
actions.description: Update a 星管家 station's monthly insurance fee (星管家保险费更新).

actions.name: station_update_xgj_waybill_fee
actions.description: Update a 星管家 waybill's dispatch and review-fee information (星管家运单及好评费更新).

actions.name: station_upload_fc_images
actions.description: Upload storefront and interior images for a Hive Box service station (丰巢服务站相册新增).

actions.name: station_upload_picture
actions.description: Upload one base64 image for a station (图片上传); the image must be at most 200 KB.

actions.name: station_upload_store_album
actions.description: Upload album images for a station (驿站相册新增), such as exterior, license, poster and signage photos.

actions.name: station_upload_village_store_images
actions.description: Upload the exterior and interior images for a township agent station (乡镇代理图片上传).

actions.name: station_upload_xgj_images
actions.description: Upload identity, face and property images for a 星管家 station (星管家相册新增); identity_file_names must contain exactly 2 images.

actions.name: station_upsert_cage_cabinet
actions.description: Create or update a cage cabinet (笼车柜); the sn field is the upsert key.

actions.name: station_upsert_fc_outsource_store
actions.description: Create or update a Hive Box regional-outsource store (丰巢区域外包门店新增及更新).

actions.name: station_upsert_robot_channel
actions.description: Create or update a robot/smart-cabinet channel station (渠道新增/修改). Omit virtual_addr when creating; pass it when updating.

actions.name: station_upsert_store_info
actions.description: Create or update a city station's base information (驿站基本信息新增/更新). When outsource_flag is 1, outsource_info is saved and required for 驿收发/丰巢 stores.

actions.name: station_upsert_ysf_outsource_store
actions.description: Create or update a 驿收发 regional-outsource store (驿收发区域外包门店新增及更新).

actions.name: station_validate_delivery_password
actions.description: Validate a customer's pickup password for a waybill at a partner station (验证取件密码).

actions.name: station_verify_delivery_permission
actions.description: Check whether a channel and courier may deliver a waybill (派件管控). The channel code is allocated by SF (联系868850).

actions.name: station_verify_fc_settlement
actions.description: Check whether a Hive Box (丰巢) cabinet drop-off fee settles monthly (丰巢订单结算校验, 订单类型 1 派件投柜). The rental and reservation order types carry different payloads and are not covered.

actions.name: station_verify_waybill_number
actions.description: Check whether a waybill number is an SF Express waybill number, for the station channel.

actions.name: submit_citywide_print
actions.description: Submit waybill print content for 大同城 citywide freight orders. Asynchronous by default: returns a print batch number to poll with sf_express.query_citywide_print_status; sync mode (max 20 documents) returns the files directly.

actions.name: update_order
actions.description: Confirm (deal_type confirm) or cancel (deal_type cancel) an SF Express order before shipment, optionally updating weight, volume, or the recipient address. Confirming requires the waybill numbers. A cancelled order number cannot be reused.

actions.name: validate_waybill_no
actions.description: Check whether a waybill number is a valid SF Express waybill number.

auth.label: Bearer Token
auth.description: SheetDB bearer token for one spreadsheet API. Find it in that API's Settings tab: https://sheetdb.io/app/apis

extraFields.label: API ID
extraFields.description: SheetDB API ID from the API URL or the APIs dashboard: https://sheetdb.io/app/apis

actions.name: count_rows
actions.description: Count data rows in the connected spreadsheet, excluding the header row.

actions.name: create_rows
actions.description: Append one or more JSON rows to the connected spreadsheet.

actions.name: delete_rows
actions.description: Delete all rows matching one spreadsheet column and value.

actions.name: get_document_name
actions.description: Get the Google Sheets document name for the connected SheetDB API.

actions.name: get_keys
actions.description: Get the column names from the first row of the connected spreadsheet.

actions.name: list_rows
actions.description: List rows from the connected SheetDB spreadsheet with optional paging and sorting.

actions.name: search_rows
actions.description: Search spreadsheet rows using dynamic column conditions and AND or OR matching.

actions.name: update_rows
actions.description: Update all rows matching one spreadsheet column and value.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Sherpa Requirements API key. Request access at https://www.joinsherpa.com/contact-business.

actions.name: get_trip_details
actions.description: Retrieve comprehensive personalized travel restrictions and document requirements for an itinerary.

actions.name: get_trip_summary
actions.description: Retrieve a concise Markdown summary of personalized travel and visa requirements for an itinerary.

auth.label: Personal Access Token
auth.description: ShipBob Personal Access Token sent with the Authorization: Bearer header. Generate one in the ShipBob dashboard under Integrations > API Tokens: https://web.shipbob.com/app/merchant/#/Integrations/token-management.

actions.name: get_inventory_level
actions.description: Get aggregated ShipBob inventory levels for one inventory item.

actions.name: list_channels
actions.description: List ShipBob channels available to the authenticated Personal Access Token.

actions.name: list_inventory_levels
actions.description: List ShipBob inventory levels with optional item and product filters.

actions.name: list_locations
actions.description: List ShipBob fulfillment network locations.

actions.name: list_products
actions.description: List ShipBob products with optional catalog filters.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: ShipStation API key used as the API-Key header for V2 API requests. Generate and copy it from your ShipStation account API settings: https://docs.shipstation.com/authentication

actions.name: get_purchase_order
actions.description: Retrieve a ShipStation V2 purchase order by ID, including detailed product lines when returned.

actions.name: list_inventory_levels
actions.description: List ShipStation V2 inventory stock levels and inventory-related properties for SKUs.

actions.name: list_inventory_warehouses
actions.description: List inventory warehouses configured in ShipStation V2.

actions.name: list_purchase_orders
actions.description: List ShipStation V2 purchase orders with optional filters and pagination.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Shipday API key used as the Authorization: Basic header value. Create or view it from the Shipday dashboard API settings: https://docs.shipday.com/reference.

actions.name: create_order
actions.description: Insert a Shipday delivery order.

actions.name: delete_order
actions.description: Delete a Shipday delivery order by order ID.

actions.name: edit_order

This is also the tool for a task that links to an item in another tool — pass `integrationUrl`, which works for a backlog task too.

actions.name: delete_all_incomplete_recurring_task_instances
actions.description: PERMANENTLY deletes incomplete instances of a recurring task and TERMINATES the series, preventing any future instances from ever being created. This is irreversible. When afterDate is provided, only instances after that date are deleted and the series is terminated at that date. When omitted, all incomplete instances are deleted. WARNING: If the user wants to temporarily skip a period (e.g. vacation) and resume the series afterwards, do NOT use this tool — use edit_task_recurrence_rule with deleteOldInstancesAfter and firstOccurrenceOnOrAfter instead.

actions.name: delete_calendar_event
actions.description: Removes a calendar event and deletes all associated tasks. If the event is a meeting then any access role can remove the event. Otherwise only owners or writers can remove the event. Note: If the event is a meeting and the user is an owner or write this will remove the event for ALL attendees.

actions.name: delete_channel
actions.description: Deletes one of the user's channels. Takes a channel ID, not a channel name — use the search_channels tool to resolve a name the user mentions into an ID first. Tasks, objectives, and calendar events in the channel are not deleted, but they lose their channel assignment and cannot be reassigned by undoing this. Deleting a category also uncategorizes the channels inside it. This cannot be undone, so confirm with the user before calling it.

actions.name: delete_task
actions.description: Deletes an existing task.

actions.name: edit_subtask_title
actions.description: Updates the title of an existing subtask.

actions.name: edit_task_due_date
actions.description: Sets or clears the due date of a task. This is the hard deadline, not the day the task is planned/scheduled for (use move_task_to_day for that).

actions.name: edit_task_notes
actions.description: Replaces the notes body of an existing task with new Markdown content. The full notes field is overwritten — use append_task_notes to add to existing notes without replacing them.

actions.name: edit_task_recurrence_rule
actions.description: Updates the recurrence rule of an existing task. This is the preferred tool for temporarily pausing or skipping a recurring task for a specific period (e.g. vacation, leave). By combining deleteOldInstancesAfter (to clear instances during the skip period) and firstOccurrenceOnOrAfter (to restart the series afterwards), you can maintain the recurrence while accommodating temporary breaks — unlike delete_all_incomplete_recurring_task_instances which permanently terminates the series. When firstOccurrenceOnOrAfter is provided, this forks the recurring series: a new series begins from that date and the old series ends the day before.

actions.name: edit_task_time_estimate
actions.description: Updates the time estimate of an existing task.

actions.name: edit_task_title
actions.description: Updates the title of an existing task.

Use this whenever the user asks how a Sunsama feature works, what Sunsama can or cannot do, or whenever you are unsure about product behavior or a limitation. Pick the most relevant article from the list, then call "get_help_article" with its id to read it and answer from the docs instead of guessing. You can also share the article url with the user.

actions.name: list_resources
actions.description:
Lists all available resources and resource templates exposed by this MCP server. Use this tool to discover what data sources are available when the client doesn't support the MCP resources protocol natively.

Returns an array of resources, where each resource has:
- name: The resource identifier
- uri: The static URI (for fixed resources) OR uri_template (for parameterized resources)
- description: What the resource provides
- mimeType: The content type returned

For templated resources, fill in the placeholders with actual values.

Example: If list_resources shows uri_template "sunsama://tasks/{calendarDay}", 
you would call this with uri "sunsama://tasks/2025-01-15" to get tasks for that day.

When set to true, tasks can be automatically projected during the event. When set to false, tasks cannot be automatically projected during the event. actions.description: Query a traditional ABO blood-type pairing interpretation. Enable TianAPI Blood Type Pairing (84). For entertainment only, not a medical compatibility assessment.

Enable TianAPI Chinese Almanac (45).

actions.description: Query one of the 24 Chinese solar terms, including its meaning, customs, poetry, and foods. An optional year requests exact Gregorian and lunar date information. Enable TianAPI Solar Terms (86).

auth.description: Add this runtime's public egress IP to the account's API IP whitelist in the 微信开发者平台 console (公众号 → 基础信息 → 开发密钥 → API IP白名单) before connecting, otherwise every API call fails with errcode 40164.

fields.label: AppID
