actions.name: add_draft
actions.description: Create an article draft with 1 to 8 articles. Cover images must be permanent material media_ids.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: add_material
actions.description: Upload a permanent media material. Permanent materials do not expire but count toward the account material quota. Size limits: image 10 MB, voice 2 MB, video 10 MB, thumb 64 KB. Video uploads require title and introduction.
providerPermissions: Upload permanent materials to the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: add_template
actions.description: Add a private template from the template library by its short id and get back the full template_id. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: batch_get_draft
actions.description: List article drafts in pages of at most 20 items.

actions.name: batch_get_material
actions.description: List permanent materials of one type in pages of at most 20 items.

actions.name: batch_get_published
actions.description: List successfully published article records in pages of at most 20 items.

actions.name: callback_check
actions.description: Check network connectivity between WeChat servers and the callback URL configured for the official account. Fails with errcode 40201 when the account has no callback URL configured.

actions.name: clear_quota
actions.description: Reset the monthly API call quota of the connected official account. The account's appId is taken from the credential. Each account can clear its quota at most 10 times per calendar month.

actions.name: delete_draft
actions.description: Permanently delete one article draft by media_id. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: delete_mass_message
actions.description: Delete a mass-sent message by msg_id. articleIdx selects one article inside the message, counting from 1; omit it to delete the whole message. Only messages sent through the API that finished sending can be deleted, and only news and video messages qualify. Deletion invalidates the article content page for everyone; users who already received the message still see its card locally. When several mass sends shared one article, deleting one send invalidates all of them.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: delete_material
actions.description: Permanently delete a permanent material by media_id. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Delete permanent materials from the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: delete_publish
actions.description: Delete a published article by article_id. index selects one article inside the published message, counting from 1; omit index to delete the whole message. Deleted articles show as unavailable to readers. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Delete published articles of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: delete_template
actions.description: Delete one private template by template_id. Only certified service accounts can use this API. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: get_all_templates
actions.description: List all private templates of the account. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: get_api_domain_ip
actions.description: Get the WeChat API server IP addresses that the official account servers may call from.

actions.name: get_article_read
actions.description: Get the daily read metrics of every published article that was read on the given day. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 1 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

actions.name: get_article_share
actions.description: Get the daily share metrics of every published article that was shared on the given day. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 1 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

actions.name: get_article_total_detail
actions.description: Get the cumulative per-article metrics for everything published in the range. Each article accumulates at most 30 days of data from its publish date. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 1 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

actions.name: get_biz_summary
actions.description: Get the per-day overview metrics aggregated across all content published in the range. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 30 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

actions.name: get_callback_ip
actions.description: Get the WeChat callback server IP addresses. Allowlist them when the official account receives message callbacks.

actions.name: get_draft
actions.description: Get the content of one article draft by media_id.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: get_draft_count
actions.description: Get the total number of article drafts of the official account.

actions.name: get_mass_message_status
actions.description: Poll the send status of a mass message task by msg_id.

actions.name: get_material
actions.description: Get a permanent material by media_id. News materials return their articles and video materials return title, description, and down_url as JSON; image and voice materials are stored in local transit storage.
providerPermissions: Download permanent materials from the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: get_material_count
actions.description: Get the permanent material counts of the official account, grouped by media type.

actions.name: get_publish_status
actions.description: Poll the status of a publish task by publish_id.
providerPermissions: Publish article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: get_published_article
actions.description: Get the content of a published article by article_id.

actions.name: get_temp_media
actions.description: Download a temporary media file by media_id. Image, voice, and thumb media are stored in local transit storage; video media returns a video_url instead.
providerPermissions: Download temporary media from the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: get_template_industry
actions.description: Get the primary and secondary industry currently set on the account. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: get_user_cumulate
actions.description: Get the per-day cumulative follower count of the official account. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 7 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

actions.name: get_user_summary
actions.description: Get per-day follower gains and losses of the official account. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 7 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

actions.name: preview_mass_message
actions.description: Preview a mass message to one follower before sending, to check its style and layout. Only certified accounts can use this API. Previewing by WeChat ID (toWxName) is limited to 100 calls per day.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: publish_draft
actions.description: Submit one article draft for publishing. The returned publish_id only means the publish task was accepted; poll get_publish_status for the result. Only certified accounts can publish.
providerPermissions: Publish article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: send_custom_message
actions.description: Send a customer service message to one follower. Only certified accounts can use this API, and the follower must have interacted with the account within the last 48 hours. content is the message-type-specific object documented per msgType.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: send_mass_message
actions.description: Mass-send a message to a list of follower OpenIDs (between 2 and 10000). Only certified accounts can mass-send: certified subscription accounts once per day, certified service accounts 4 times per calendar month. A successful response only means the task was accepted; poll get_mass_message_status for the result.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: send_mass_message_by_tag
actions.description: Mass-send a message to all followers or to one follower tag. Only certified accounts can mass-send: certified subscription accounts once per day, certified service accounts 4 times per calendar month. A successful response only means the task was accepted; poll get_mass_message_status for the result.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: send_template_message
actions.description: Send a template message to one follower. Only certified service accounts can use this API. data maps each template keyword to {value, color?}.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: set_template_industry
actions.description: Set the primary and secondary industry of the account, which decides which template library entries are available. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: set_typing_status
actions.description: Show or hide the customer service typing indicator for one follower. Only certified accounts can use this API, and the follower must have interacted with the account within the last 48 hours.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: update_draft
actions.description: Replace one article inside a draft. index is zero-based: the first article is 0.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: upload_article_image
actions.description: Upload an image used inside article HTML content and get back its WeChat-hosted URL. Only the returned URL renders inside article content. JPG/PNG only, at most 1 MB. Does not consume the material quota.
providerPermissions: Upload article images to the connected WeChat Official Account

actions.name: upload_temp_media
actions.description: Upload a temporary media file to the official account. Temporary media expires 3 days after upload. Size limits: image 10 MB, voice 2 MB, video 10 MB, thumb 64 KB.
providerPermissions: Upload temporary media to the connected WeChat Official Account

provider.description: Run a WeChat Store (微信小店) through the WeChat Store Open Platform APIs: upload product images, create and update products, list and delist them, manage stock, query and ship orders, look up freight templates and addresses, and process after-sale requests. If the store has an IP whitelist configured in the WeChat Store admin console (微信小店后台 → 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研 → IP 白名单), the runtime's public egress IP must be added to it, otherwise every call fails with HTTP 403.

auth.description: The AppID and AppSecret of the WeChat Store (微信小店), found in the WeChat Store admin console (微信小店后台 → 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研). If the store has an IP whitelist configured there (自研 → IP 白名单), add this runtime's public egress IP to it first, otherwise every API call fails with HTTP 403.

fields.label: AppID
fields.description: The AppID of the WeChat Store. Find it in the WeChat Store admin console (微信小店后台) under 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研.

fields.label: AppSecret
fields.description: The AppSecret of the same WeChat Store, shown next to the AppID under 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研. If the store has an IP whitelist configured (自研 → IP 白名单), this runtime's public egress IP must be added to it first.

actions.name: accept_aftersale
actions.description: Accept a buyer's after-sale request. Accepting a return needs a merchant address id from list_addresses; acceptType chooses between accepting the return (1) and accepting the refund (2), and is chosen automatically when omitted.
providerPermissions: Manage the after-sale orders of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: add_product
actions.description: Create a product. All image fields must be WeChat-hosted URLs from upload_image. By default the product is saved as a draft; pass listing 1 to submit it for review and list it directly. Nested objects and arrays keep their WeChat snake_case fields as documented per field.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: apply_category
actions.description: Apply for permission to sell in a leaf category using the new category tree and certificate groups. Returns an audit id; check the audit and effective permission before publishing products.
providerPermissions: Apply for categories in the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: delete_product
actions.description: Permanently delete a product by product_id. A product under review cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: delisting_product
actions.description: Take a listed product off the shelf.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: get_address
actions.description: Get one merchant address by address_id, including its contact, region, and send/recv flags. Accepting an after-sale return needs one of these address ids.

actions.name: get_aftersale_order
actions.description: Get one after-sale order by its id, including its status, type, products, and refund details.

actions.name: get_category
actions.description: Get the publishing rules of one leaf category: required product and sale attributes, brand restrictions, deposit, and qualifications.

actions.name: get_category_application
actions.description: Get the status and any rejection reason of a category application by audit id.

actions.name: get_category_product_rule
actions.description: Get the category's product attribute, sale attribute, qualification, price, and other publishing rules for the chosen release mode.

actions.name: get_freight_template
actions.description: Get one freight template by template_id, including its valuation type, shipping method, sender address, and freight rules. Freight templates bind to products through expressInfo on add_product.

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Get one order by order_id, including its products, payment, price, and delivery details. Buyer address fields are masked.

actions.name: get_product
actions.description: Get one product by product_id. Products keep a draft and an online copy; dataType selects which.

actions.name: get_shop_info
actions.description: Get the basic information of the connected WeChat Store: name, avatar, subject type, and status.

actions.name: list_addresses
actions.description: List the merchant address ids of the store. After-sale returns need one of these address ids when accepting a return.

actions.name: list_aftersale_orders
actions.description: List the after-sale order ids of the store, paginated by cursor. At least one time range pair is required, as Unix timestamps in seconds spanning at most 24 hours.

actions.name: list_categories
actions.description: Get the full category tree of the store, including the qualifications each category requires. Use the leaf cat_id values from cats_v2 for add_product and get_category.

actions.name: list_category_permissions
actions.description: List the store's category permissions. Filter to status 1 to find categories currently allowed for sale.

actions.name: list_delivery_companies
actions.description: List the delivery companies the store can ship with, including each company's delivery_id.

actions.name: list_freight_templates
actions.description: List the freight template ids of the store.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List the order ids of the store, paginated by cursor. At least one time range is required, as a pair of Unix timestamps in seconds spanning at most 7 days.

actions.name: list_products
actions.description: List the product ids of the store, paginated by cursor.

actions.name: list_valid_brands
actions.description: List the brand qualifications currently in effect for the store, paginated by cursor. Use a returned brand_id when adding a product in a brand-restricted category.

actions.name: listing_product
actions.description: Submit a product for review and list it once approved.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: precheck_product_category
actions.description: Check whether the store may publish in a leaf category, including category permission, deposit, freight insurance, and store restrictions. Omit catId for store-wide checks only.

actions.name: reject_aftersale
actions.description: Reject a buyer's after-sale request with a reason.
providerPermissions: Manage the after-sale orders of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: send_delivery
actions.description: Ship an order, in one or more packages. Each package either ships by express with a waybill (deliverType 1, needs waybillId and deliveryId from list_delivery_companies, or OTHER when the company is not listed) or delivers virtual goods without logistics (deliverType 3, only for orders whose products use the phone-number delivery method).
providerPermissions: Manage the orders of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: update_order_merchant_notes
actions.description: Replace the merchant note of one order, optionally with a tag color.
providerPermissions: Manage the orders of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: update_product
actions.description: Replace a product's editable data. This is a full overwrite: every field of add_product applies, SKUs that carry an existing sku_id are updated, SKUs without one are added, and previously existing SKUs missing from the list are deleted.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: update_product_stock
actions.description: Update the stock of a product's SKUs. This does not consume the product review quota.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: upload_image
actions.description: Upload an image to the store and get back its WeChat-hosted URL (mmecimage.cn), the only URL form accepted by product image fields. Provide either imageUrl for WeChat to fetch, or a local transit file with its pixel size. At most 10 MB per image.
providerPermissions: Upload images to the connected WeChat Store

actions.name: upload_qualification_image
actions.description: Upload a qualification image (up to 2 MB) and return the file_id required for category and brand applications. Product images from upload_image cannot be used here.
providerPermissions: Upload qualification images to the connected WeChat Store

actions.description: Audit a Xiaohongshu after-sale request. Only callable while the after-sale is pending seller audit.

actions.name: confirm_after_sale_receive
actions.description: Confirm receipt of a buyer-returned package for a Xiaohongshu after-sale. Only callable while the after-sale waits for seller receipt.

actions.name: create_item
actions.description: Create a Xiaohongshu item with its SKUs. Typical setup order: list_categories, get_category_attributes, search_brands, list_carriage_templates, list_logistics_plans, then upload_material for the images.

actions.name: deliver_order
actions.description: Ship a Xiaohongshu order with an express tracking number. Supports split shipments by passing the SKU IDs of one package.

actions.name: get_after_sale
actions.description: Get a Xiaohongshu after-sale record by its after-sale ID, including SKUs, amounts, and logistics.

actions.name: get_category_attributes
actions.description: Get the attributes and validation rules of a leaf Xiaohongshu category.

actions.name: get_item
actions.description: Get a Xiaohongshu item by its item ID, including its SKU list.

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Get a Xiaohongshu order by its order ID, including SKU, amount, and delivery package details.

actions.name: get_order_declare_info
actions.description: Get the customs declaration identity information of a cross-border Xiaohongshu order.

actions.name: get_order_receiver_info
actions.description: Get receiver addresses for Xiaohongshu orders. Only available while an order is pending shipment; call it right before printing shipping labels.

actions.name: get_order_tracking
actions.description: Get the logistics tracking records of every package in a Xiaohongshu order.

actions.name: get_sku_stock
actions.description: Get the sellable, total, and occupied stock of a Xiaohongshu SKU, including per-warehouse breakdowns.

actions.name: list_address_records
actions.description: List the seller address records of the Xiaohongshu shop, including return addresses. sellerAddressRecordId is required when agreeing to a return shipment in audit_after_sale.

actions.name: list_after_sale_reject_reasons
actions.description: List the reject reason options available when auditing or confirming receipt of a Xiaohongshu after-sale.

actions.name: list_after_sales
actions.description: List Xiaohongshu after-sale records by order or by creation/update time. Pass an order ID, or a time window (24 hours by creation time, 30 minutes by update time).

actions.name: list_carriage_templates
actions.description: List the carriage (freight) templates of the Xiaohongshu shop.

actions.name: list_categories
actions.description: List the Xiaohongshu item categories under a parent category, or the top-level categories.

actions.name: list_express_companies
actions.description: List the express companies supported by Xiaohongshu for order shipment.

actions.name: list_item_skus
actions.description: List Xiaohongshu items together with their full SKU details such as price, stock, and logistics plan.

actions.name: list_items
actions.description: List Xiaohongshu items with basic fields using ID, time, stock, barcode, or availability filters.

actions.name: list_logistics_plans
actions.description: List the logistics plans of the Xiaohongshu shop. planInfoId is the logisticsPlanId used when creating SKUs.

actions.name: list_materials
actions.description: List materials in the Xiaohongshu material center, for example to check an upload status.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List Xiaohongshu orders by creation or update time. startTime and endTime are Unix timestamps in seconds, while the returned order times are in milliseconds. Creation-time windows are limited to 24 hours and update-time windows to 30 minutes.

actions.name: list_supported_ports
actions.description: List the customs ports supported by Xiaohongshu for cross-border clearance.

actions.name: modify_order_express
actions.description: Change the express tracking number of a shipped Xiaohongshu order. Only available after shipment and before receipt.

actions.name: modify_order_remark
actions.description: Modify the seller remark and flag of a Xiaohongshu order.

actions.name: refresh_token
actions.description: Refresh the access token using the refresh token stored in the connection credential. Xiaohongshu only issues new tokens when the access token has under 30 minutes left or has expired; otherwise it returns the current ones unchanged. A changed token set must be saved back to the connection, and the old access token stays valid for only 5 more minutes. Access tokens expire after 7 days.

actions.name: resend_payment_record
actions.description: Ask Xiaohongshu to notify the payment company to push the payment record to customs again for a bonded cross-border order.

actions.name: search_brands
actions.description: Search the brands available for a leaf Xiaohongshu category.

actions.name: search_items
actions.description: Search Xiaohongshu items with full publish fields using keywords, item codes, or availability filters.

actions.name: set_sku_availability
actions.description: List or delist a Xiaohongshu SKU.

actions.name: ship_after_sale_exchange
actions.description: Confirm receipt of the returned package and report the exchange shipment tracking number for a Xiaohongshu exchange after-sale.

actions.name: sync_sku_stock
actions.description: Set the total stock of a Xiaohongshu SKU. Xiaohongshu derives the sellable stock from the difference with occupied and channel stock.

actions.name: update_item
actions.description: Update a Xiaohongshu item and its SKUs: edit item fields, change existing SKUs through updateSkuList, add new ones through createSkuList, and remove SKUs through deleteSkuIdList.

actions.name: upload_material
actions.description: Upload an image or video to the Xiaohongshu material center and get its url for use in item images.

auth.label: API Token

actions.name: calculate_comparison_chart
actions.description: Calculate a comparison chart for two people, including both planetary sets and their relationship to the houses.

actions.name: calculate_composite_chart

actions.name: calculate_lunar_return_chart
actions.description: Calculate a lunar return chart from birth details and a reference date, time, and return location.

actions.name: calculate_natal_chart
actions.description: Calculate a personal natal chart from birth time and location, with optional SVG, interpretation corpus, and aspect patterns.

actions.name: calculate_solar_return_chart
actions.description: Calculate a solar return chart from birth details and a reference date, time, and location. In verified upstream probes, changing the reference location did not change the birth-location houses; relocated solar returns remain unverified.

actions.name: calculate_synastry_chart
actions.description: Calculate Xingpan's pairing (synastry) chart for two people.

actions.name: calculate_transit_chart
actions.description: Calculate a transit chart against a natal chart for a specified local date and time at the birthplace, accounting for date-specific UTC offsets.

actions.name: get_chart_config
actions.description: Get Xingpan planet, asteroid, fixed star, virtual point, zodiac, and house configuration.

actions.name: get_daily_horoscope
actions.description: Get daily zodiac horoscopes for one sign or all twelve signs, including overall, love, career, health, scores, and lucky items.

auth.label: MCP Token
auth.description: Copy your MCP Token from the XYDC platform console for Authorization bearer authentication. Follow https://platform.xydc.com/docs/mcp-access. Use the MCP Token, not a REST API Key.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current XYDC MCP tool with JSON arguments matching its live schema. Calls may consume Credits. Each successful generate_category_insight_resource call costs 500 Credits, including existing resources; reuse the returned resource and do not blindly retry generation. Connector waits at most 55 seconds for generation. A timeout does not confirm upstream cancellation or prevent charges; the result may be unknown. Do not automatically retry generation after a timeout.

actions.name: generate_category_insight_resource
actions.description: Generate a category insight resource for a user-confirmed marketplace and category. XYDC waits up to five minutes and rebuilds failed resources internally. Each independent successful call costs 500 Credits, including existing-resource hits. Reuse resourceId for subsequent queries; do not blindly retry. Connector waits at most 55 seconds for generation. A timeout does not confirm upstream cancellation or prevent charges; the result may be unknown. Do not automatically retry generation after a timeout. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_asin_ad_change_trends
actions.description: Get daily newly observed advertising campaigns for one ASIN. This does not establish whether existing campaigns stopped, decreased, were deleted or remain active. Use traffic trends for traffic changes.

actions.name: get_asin_bsr_trends
actions.description: Get daily BSR category-ranking trends for one ASIN. Supports US, CA, MX, BR, UK, DE, FR, ES, IT and JP; this is not keyword ranking.

actions.name: get_asin_info
actions.description: Get product titles, prices, currencies, star ratings, rating counts, images and Amazon links for up to 100 ASINs sharing one marketplace.

actions.name: get_asin_info_change_trends
actions.description: Get daily changes to one ASIN title and main image, including current and previous values. Use get_asin_info_trends for prices, ratings and promotions.

actions.name: get_asin_info_trends
actions.description: Get daily rating counts, stars, displayed/list/deal/Prime prices, coupons, promotions and subscription offers for one ASIN. Longer date ranges cost more.

actions.name: get_asin_keyword_count_trends
actions.description: Get daily keyword counts and distributions for ASINs sharing one marketplace. Covers organic/advertising, ranking bands, head/long-tail and acquisition-rate groups. Keyword-count growth does not prove traffic growth.

actions.name: get_asin_keyword_rank_hourly
actions.description: Get hourly rankings of one ASIN for one keyword on one day. Supports US, UK and DE; use daily trends for multiple days.

actions.name: get_asin_keyword_rank_trends
actions.description: Get daily rankings of one ASIN for one keyword over a date range.

actions.name: get_asin_keyword_traffic_trends
actions.description: Get daily organic, advertising and placement-level traffic for one ASIN and keyword.

actions.name: get_asin_keywords
actions.description: Reverse-search keywords bringing rankings and traffic to one ASIN in the latest seven-day snapshot. Use daily or monthly tools for historical dates.

actions.name: get_asin_keywords_daily
actions.description: Get historical daily reverse-search keywords, rankings and traffic for one ASIN over a date range.

actions.name: get_asin_keywords_monthly
actions.description: Get historical monthly reverse-search keywords, rankings and traffic for one ASIN over a month range.

actions.name: get_asin_order_trends
actions.description: Get monthly order counts for one ASIN over an explicit month range. Use get_asin_orders_last_30_days for recent orders.

actions.name: get_asin_orders_last_30_days
actions.description: Get recent order counts for one or more ASINs, measured over the last 30 days.

actions.name: get_asin_traffic
actions.description: Get the latest seven-day organic, advertising and total traffic scores and period-over-period changes for one or more ASINs.

actions.name: get_asin_traffic_trends
actions.description: Get daily organic, advertising and placement-level traffic-score trends for one ASIN.

actions.name: get_asin_traffic_trends_monthly
actions.description: Get monthly organic, advertising and placement-level traffic-score trends for one ASIN.

actions.name: get_asin_traffic_trends_weekly
actions.description: Get weekly organic, advertising and placement-level traffic-score trends for one ASIN. Weeks run Monday through Sunday.

actions.name: get_asin_variations
actions.description: Get the parent ASIN, child ASINs and variation attributes for one ASIN.

actions.name: get_category_brand_market_size
actions.description: Get category brand market-size lists and complete trends, with monthly or last-30-day periods, price bands, rankings, sorting and pagination. Costs 5 Credits per 5 returned brands. newRelease sorts by descending sales and does not filter new brands; rankingType overrides orders. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_brand_sales_trends
actions.description: Get complete historical monthly sales trends and existing last-30-day summaries for specified brands; month-range filtering is unsupported. Cost: ceil((maximum historical months + 1) / 6) times requested brand count times 2 Credits. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_keyword_analysis
actions.description: Get category keyword summary, distribution and complete trends for one calendar month and an explicit correlationType. Omit the month for the latest available keyword month. Costs 5 Credits including trends; yearly, daily and rolling periods are unsupported. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_keywords
actions.description: Get category keywords for one calendar month, with correlation, brand, range, text and pagination filters. Omit the month for the latest available keyword month. Includes full historical trends unless includeTrend=false. Costs 1 Credit per 20 keywords. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_market_size_trends
actions.description: Get complete historical monthly category sales trends across all price bands and existing last-30-day summaries. Month-range filtering is unsupported. Costs 5 Credits per 6 historical months; last-30-day summaries add no charge. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_new_release_opportunity_trends
actions.description: Get category new-release opportunity summary, list, full trends and periods. Costs 5 Credits per 6 trend months; lists and periods add no charge. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_new_release_ranking
actions.description: Get category new-release rankings for required reportPeriod: YYYY-MM, YYYY, last30days or last12months. Set rangeFilters.streetDays explicitly: there is no default listing-age limit, so unfiltered results are not necessarily new products. Costs 5 Credits per 5 representative ASINs. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_price_segment_trends
actions.description: Get low, middle and high price-band analysis and full trends, with period prices, brands, representative ASINs, ratings and subranges. Historical trends do not contain monthly price boundaries. Costs 5 Credits per 6 distinct months across all bands. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_primary_asins
actions.description: Get representative ASINs and complete trends for a category or price band, with rankings, sorting and pagination. last12months only supports all price bands. Costs 5 Credits per 5 representative ASINs; rankingType overrides orders. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_review_analysis
actions.description: Get combined category star-rating and rating-count distributions and complete trends for a calendar month or the last 30 days. Costs 5 Credits per successful call. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_sales_ranking
actions.description: Get category sales rankings aggregated by primaryAsin for required reportPeriod: YYYY-MM, YYYY, last30days or last12months, with brand/range filters, sorting and pagination. Costs 5 Credits per 5 returned representative ASINs, rounded up. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_seasonality
actions.description: Get category seasonality, peak/off seasons, sales comparisons and forecasts. Both nonseasonal and indeterminate results use isSeasonal=false with empty analysis; request failures are errors. Costs 5 Credits per successful call. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_category_surging_ranking
actions.description: Get category surging-product rankings for required reportPeriod: YYYY-MM, YYYY, last30days or last12months, with growth rules, filtering and sorting. Costs 5 Credits per 5 representative ASINs. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: get_keyword_aba_trends
actions.description: Get weekly ABA search-volume trends for up to 100 keywords and at most 52 calendar weeks. ABA weeks run Sunday through Saturday, unlike ASIN traffic weeks.

actions.name: get_keyword_advertising_replay
actions.description: Replay hourly advertising placements for one keyword on one day in US, UK or DE, returning up to 24 hours of placement competition.

actions.name: get_keyword_analysis_monthly
actions.description: Get monthly ASIN competition, rankings and traffic for one keyword over a month range.

actions.name: get_keyword_asin_analysis
actions.description: Reverse-search competing ASINs and their rankings and traffic for one keyword in the latest seven-day snapshot.

actions.name: get_keyword_info
actions.description: Get the latest weekly search volume, ABA ranking, competition difficulty and suggested bids for up to 100 keywords in one marketplace.

actions.name: get_multi_asin_keyword_comparison
actions.description: Compare latest seven-day keyword coverage, rankings and traffic across up to 20 ASINs when the user requests comparison or keyword-library building. Do not silently combine independent ASIN queries.

actions.name: get_multi_asin_keyword_comparison_monthly
actions.description: Compare historical monthly keyword coverage, rankings and traffic across up to 20 ASINs for comparison or keyword-library building.

actions.name: get_parent_asin_keywords
actions.description: Get latest seven-day keywords across all children of one parent. Supply one child ASIN; XYDC resolves its parent. Use only for an explicitly requested parent-level analysis.

actions.name: get_parent_asin_keywords_monthly
actions.description: Get historical monthly keywords across all children of one parent. Supply one child ASIN; XYDC resolves its parent. Use only for an explicitly requested parent-level analysis.

actions.name: get_primary_asin_children
actions.description: Get children and complete trends for one representative primaryAsin string, with reporting periods, price bands and pagination. Costs 5 Credits per 20 child ASINs. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current XYDC MCP tools, behavior annotations, and live input schemas before choosing a tool to call.

actions.name: read_category_insight_guide
actions.description: Read the official XYDC category insight workflow before a category analysis: marketplace and category confirmation, resource generation, reuse, reporting periods, pagination and Credits.

actions.name: report_missing_xiyou_capability
actions.description: Submit a missing-capability feedback event to XYDC when requested by the user. This records product feedback, not Amazon data, and should not be used for ordinary input errors. Redact sensitive information before submission.

actions.name: search_market_insight_categories
actions.description: Search Amazon categories by keyword or ASIN, returning paths, representative-ASIN counts, availability and existing translations. Free. Present candidates and obtain user confirmation before generating a category resource, even for one candidate. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.
